tm.虹色の枝を探し 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\n仮面武闘会が開かれる グロッ:
{var:1} and friends, still seeking the
Rainbough, visit Octagonia, home of the
Masked Tourney. Learning the grand prize
is the very Rainbough they seek, the party
resolves to enter.

{var:1} and friends, still seeking the
Rainbough, visit Octagonia, home of the
Masked Tourney. Learning the grand prize
is the very Rainbough they seek, the party
decides to enter.
tm.受け付けで 大会の参加資格である仮面と\n１１と書かれた抽選番号を受け取った {:
At the reception desk, {var:1} receives
a mask, the entry requirement, and a lottery
number: 11. {var:1} then heads for the
arena, where the lottery will decide the
partners.
tm.抽選会では 謎の老人による 突然のペア変更を経て\n{var:1}は 前大会のチ:
At the lottery, a mysterious old man
suddenly swaps the pairings, and {var:1}
ends up partnered with Hunfrey, the
previous champion. The excitement ends,
and the contestants leave the arena.
tm.虹色の枝を探し 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nグロッタの町で開かれる 仮面:
Seeking the Rainbough, {var:1} resolves
to enter the Masked Tourney in Octagonia,
whose grand prize is that very branch. The
lottery pairs {var:1} with Hunfrey, the
previous champion.
tm.抽選会の後 {var:1}が セーニャと合流すると\n突然 受け付けの外から さ:
After the lottery, {var:1} rejoins Serena
when a commotion breaks out outside the
reception. Serena has a bad feeling about
it.
tm.抽選会の後 {var:1}が受け付けの外に向かうと\n出場者のガレムソンとベロニ:
After the lottery, {var:1} finds
Garamson and Veronica arguing. Hunfrey
calms them, says he'll fetch {var:1} from
the inn before tomorrow's match, and
heads home to the orphanage.
tm.抽選会の後に ガレムソンとベロニカの口論を収めた\nハンフリーは {var:1}:
True to his word, Hunfrey, who calmed the
quarrel between Garamson and Veronica,
visits the inn on the day of the qualifiers
and urges {var:1} to come to the arena.
tm.仮面武闘会の予選で {var:1}とハンフリーのペアは\nガレムソンとベロリンマ:
In the qualifiers, {var:1} and Hunfrey
beat Ballyhoo and Garamson. As a
mysterious old man and a woman martial
artist show overwhelming strength, the pair
keep winning and earn a place in the finals.
tm.予選大会が終わり 決勝トーナメントへの出場を決めた後\n{var:1}が 仲間た:
With a finals spot secured, {var:1}
rejoins the others when the mysterious pair
who showed such strength in the qualifiers
appear: Rab and Jade.
tm.見事 決勝トーナメントへの出場を決めた{var:1}は\nセーニャから 闘士が行:
Having reached the finals, {var:1} hears
from Serena of fighters going missing and
visits Hunfrey's orphanage. {var:1}
listens as Hunfrey explains he fights for
prize money for the children.
tm.すっかり話しこみ 夜もふけたころ\n突然 ハンフリーの部屋から 大きな物音がする:
As the talk drags on and night falls, a loud
noise suddenly comes from Hunfrey's room.
"Someone's there!" he cries, and rushes off.
tm.見事 決勝トーナメントへの出場を決めた{var:1}は\nセーニャから 闘士が行:
Having reached the finals, {var:1} hears
from Serena of fighters going missing and
visits Hunfrey's orphanage to ask him. While
he talks, a loud noise suddenly comes from
Hunfrey's room.
tm.{var:1}たちが 部屋に駆けつけると\n室内は荒らされており 犯人の姿は す:
{var:1} and friends rush to the room to
find it ransacked and the culprit gone.
Hunfrey is furious at the intruder but soon
calms down, and suggests {var:1} rest
for tomorrow's match.
tm.仮面武闘会の 決勝トーナメントが始まり\n順調に勝ち進んだ {var:1}と ハ:
The Masked Tourney finals begin.
{var:1} and Hunfrey win their way to the
final, where they face Rab and Jade. During
the fight, Rab and Jade catch sight of the
mark on the back of {var:1}'s hand.
tm.アザを目撃し ひるむ ロウとマルティナに対して\n{var:1}とハンフリーが:
Shaken by the mark on {var:1}'s hand,
Rab and Jade are beaten by {var:1} and
Hunfrey, who win the tournament. But their
joy is short-lived: during the awards
ceremony, Hunfrey suddenly collapses.
tm.{var:1}とハンフリーは 優勝を勝ちとるが\n表彰式の最中に ハンフリーが倒:
{var:1} and Hunfrey win the tournament,
but Hunfrey collapses during the ceremony.
Rab then visits {var:1} and asks for help
finding the missing Jade, and the party
heads to Hunfrey's orphanage.
tm.虹色の枝を探し 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nグロッタの町の 仮面武闘会に:
Seeking the Rainbough, {var:1} won the
Masked Tourney, but partner Hunfrey
collapsed during the ceremony. Asked by
Rab to find the missing Jade, the party
visits the orphanage where she vanished.
tm.孤児院から迷路のような洞くつに向かった 一行は\n奥で ハンフリーと アラクラト:
The party enters a maze-like cave and finds
Hunfrey with a monster, Arachtor. It needs
fighters' essence to heal, and Hunfrey had
been feeding it fighters in return for the
essence's power.
tm.ハンフリーは 武闘会に勝ち続け 賞金をかせいできたが\nエキスの影響で 彼の身体:
Hunfrey's body is at its limit from the
essence. After the party defeats Arachtor,
he repents helping the monster to protect
the orphanage, and the interrupted
ceremony resumes.
tm.虹色の枝を探し 旅を続ける {var:1}は\nグロッタの町の 仮面武闘会に出場:
{var:1}, still searching for the
Rainbough, won the Masked Tourney in
Octagonia. Now {var:1} attends the
awards ceremony with partner Hunfrey,
freed from Arachtor's control.
tm.表彰式が行われる中 自分の罪に けじめをつけたいと\nハンフリーから エキシビシ:
During the ceremony, Hunfrey asks for an
exhibition match to atone for his sins, and
{var:1} wins. Hunfrey, weakened without
the essence, still earns the crowd's praise
for his fighting spirit and achievements.
tm.いよいよ {var:1}に 優勝賞品の虹色の枝が\n贈呈されるはずだったが 枝は:
{var:1} is about to be presented with
the grand prize, the Rainbough, but it has
been stolen. A note left beside a familiar
mask says to meet {var:1} at Dundrasil
Ruins, {var:1}'s homeland...
tm.虹色の枝を探し 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nロウに盗まれてしまった 虹色:
Seeking the Rainbough that Rab stole,
{var:1} and friends visit Dundrasil Ruins,
{var:1}'s homeland. Monsters destroyed
it sixteen years ago, and {var:1}'s
parents are said to have died then.
tm.ロウと再会し 一行は枝を返すよう告げるが それに対し\n{var:1}が勇者であ:
Reunited with Rab, the party demands the
branch back. Rab asks if it's because
{var:1} is the Luminary, saying he
thought {var:1} dead sixteen years ago,
then leads them off.
tm.ロウは 一行をユグノア国王夫妻の墓まで 案内すると\n国王夫妻が 自分の娘夫婦で:
Rab leads the party to the grave of the
Dundrasil king and queen and confesses
they were his daughter and her husband,
and that he is {var:1}'s grandfather. He
asks {var:1} to join him in a requiem rite.
tm.再会したロウは {var:1}が勇者だと知っており\nユグノア国王夫妻の墓まで:
Rab, who knows {var:1} is the Luminary,
leads {var:1} to the royal couple's grave,
confesses he is {var:1}'s grandfather,
and asks to perform the family's requiem
rite.
tm.ロウに言われるまま 一行が ユグノア城跡の裏山を登ると\nそこでは マルティナが:
As Rab bids, the party climbs the hill behind
the ruins, where Jade has prepared the
rite. After the rite, Rab reads the queen's
letter that {var:1} hands him and,
overcome, asks to be left alone.
tm.再会したロウは 国王夫妻が 自分の娘夫婦であり\n自分こそが {var:1}の:
Rab confesses he is {var:1}'s
grandfather and asks to perform the royal
family's requiem rite. After it, he receives
the queen's letter from {var:1} and is
overcome.
tm.ロウのもとを離れた {var:1}は 山道で\n１６年前の悲劇に涙する マルティ:
Leaving Rab, {var:1} sees Jade on the
mountain path weeping over the tragedy of
sixteen years ago. As Jade tells {var:1}
about the queen, they spot Heliodorian
soldiers below and head to meet the others.
tm.実の祖父である ロウと共に ユグノア城跡の裏山で\n{var:1}は 亡き両親で:
{var:1} performed the requiem rite for
the late king and queen with grandfather
Rab. Hearing of the queen from Jade,
{var:1} spots Heliodorian soldiers and
tries to rejoin the others.
tm.だが グレイグ率いる デルカダール兵たちに取り囲まれ\n{var:1}は 断崖へ:
But Hendrik and his Heliodorian soldiers
surround them and drive {var:1} to a
cliff. Jade holds off Hendrik's assault, then
leaps off the cliff to save {var:1}, who
has fallen as the ground gave way.
tm.虹色の枝を探し 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nロウに盗まれてしまった 虹色:
Seeking the Rainbough stolen by Rab,
{var:1} visits Dundrasil Ruins,
{var:1}'s homeland. Rab, who claims to
be {var:1}'s grandfather, asks
{var:1} to join him in a requiem rite.
tm.鎮魂の儀式を終えた {var:1}の前に\n追っ手であるデルカダール兵を率いた:
After the rite, Hendrik appears with the
pursuing Heliodorian soldiers. Jade holds
off his assault, then leaps off the cliff to
save {var:1}, who has fallen as the
ground gave way.
tm.その後 山小屋で目覚めた {var:1}は\nマルティナから 自分が デルカダー:
{var:1} wakes in a mountain hut, where
Jade reveals she is Heliodor's princess and
has been investigating the tragedy of
sixteen years ago. They set out to join Rab
and the others who pursued it with her.
tm.鎮魂の儀式を終えた {var:1}とマルティナは\nグレイグたちに追いつめられ:
After the rite, Hendrik corners {var:1}
and Jade, and they fall into the river.
{var:1} wakes in a hut to learn that
Jade, who saved {var:1}, is the princess
of Heliodor.
tm.{var:1}とマルティナは 山小屋を出るが そこへ\nふたりを追ってきた グレ:
{var:1} and Jade leave the hut, but the
pursuing Hendrik blocks them. Jade shields
{var:1} and fights him, and though
outmatched, seizes a moment's opening to
escape with {var:1}.
tm.山小屋を出た {var:1}とマルティナの前に\nふたりを追ってきた グレイグが:
Leaving the hut, {var:1} and Jade are
blocked by the pursuing Hendrik. Thanks to
Jade's quick thinking, they flee to the ruins
of Dundrasil's castle town and reunite with
Rab and the others.
tm.{var:1}たちは ロウから このロトゼタシアの\n黒幕たる存在が 魔道士ウル:
Rab tells the party that the mastermind
behind Erdrea's troubles is the sorcerer
Mordegon. Seeking the power in Yggdrasil
to oppose him, {var:1} holds the
Rainbough, but it does not respond.
tm.鎮魂の儀式を終えた {var:1}は グレイグの\n度重なる襲撃を受け 何度も:
{var:1} survives Hendrik's repeated
attacks thanks to Jade's quick thinking.
Rejoining Rab, they agree that they need
power to defeat Mordegon, the mastermind
behind it all.
tm.ユグノア城下町跡を出ようとした瞬間 ロウから渡された\n虹色の枝が 突然 光り輝:
As the party leaves the ruins, the
Rainbough glows and shows them six orbs
and an altar in the sky. Sure that gathering
the orbs for the altar will open the way to
Yggdrasil, they set out to find them.
tm.{var:1}は 世界中を回って オーブを集めるには\nソルティコの町の水門から:
Rab says that to gather the orbs they must
pass the Puerto Valor sluice gate to the
open sea. The party heads there to find
Diego, Rab's acquaintance who manages
the gate.
tm.虹色の枝を探し 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nついに 虹色の枝を手に入れる:
{var:1} and friends finally hold the
Rainbough. Guided by it, they must gather
the remaining four orbs to reach Yggdrasil
and gain the power to defeat Mordegon.
tm.オーブを求め 世界を巡るため 外海への水門がある\nソルティコの町へ 向かうこと:
The party heads to Puerto Valor to reach
the sluice gate. Diego is away, but his butler
Cesar opens the gate on his behalf.

The party visits Diego's mansion in Puerto
Valor to reach the sluice gate. Diego is
away, but his butler Cesar opens the gate,
and the party sets out to sea.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\n妖艶なる美女の壁画で にぎわう:
Searching for orbs, {var:1} arrives in
Phnom Nonh, busy with a mural of an
enchanting beauty, and meets a lost girl
named Mel.
tm.{var:1}は シルビアと手分けして\nメルの両親を探すことになり\n一路 村:
{var:1} and Sylvando split up to look for
Mel's parents, and {var:1} heads to the
village ruins.
tm.メルの両親を見つけるために訪れた 遺跡の中で\n{var:1}は 巨大な壁画を目:
In the ruins, {var:1} sees a huge mural.
Crowds have come to view it, but Mel's
parents aren't among them, so the party
leaves to tell Mel.
tm.しかし 村の中に メルの姿は見当たらず\n{var:1}は ボンサックという男の:
Mel is nowhere in the village. A man named
Bonsack lets {var:1} stay at his wife's
inn, but with no leads there, the party
resumes the search for the missing Mel.
tm.しかし メルの両親を探す途中 彼女の姿は消え\n{var:1}たちは 遺跡にある:
While searching for Mel's parents, Mel
vanishes and the party is dragged into the
huge mural in the ruins. They step into the
strange mural world to find her.
tm.そして その直後 {var:1}たちは\n妖艶なる美女が描かれた 巨大な絵の前で:
Right after, {var:1} sees people
wandering like sleepwalkers before a huge
picture of an enchanting beauty. Anxious,
the party presses on to find Mel quickly.
tm.壁画世界を進む {var:1}たちは\nその道中 巨大な茨に襲われる。\n{va:
Moving through the mural world, the party
is attacked by giant thorns. The Luminary's
power saves them in the nick of time, and
they press deeper to escape.
tm.しかし メルの両親を探す途中 彼女の姿は消え\n{var:1}たちは 遺跡にある:
Searching for Mel's parents, Mel vanishes
and the party is dragged into the huge
mural. Attacked by giant thorns, they
escape thanks to {var:1}'s power.
tm.茨から逃れた先にあった 石碑から\nメルの正体をつかんだ {var:1}たちは\:
From a stone tablet past the thorns, the
party learns Mel's true identity. They leave
the mural world and return to the village to
warn the villagers.
tm.しかし メルの正体は\n壁画世界を創った 魔の者であると判明する。\n{var::
But Mel turns out to be the dark being who
created the mural world. The party goes
back into the mural world to chase her.
tm.しかし メルの正体は\n壁画世界を創った 魔女 メルトアであると判明する。\n{:
Mel turns out to be Meltoa, the witch who
made the mural world. When the party
defeats her, a crack appears through which
to escape the mural world.

Mel turns out to be Meltoa, the witch who
made the mural world. When the party
defeats her, those trapped in the mural are
freed safely.
tm.プチャラオ村にも ウルノーガの魔の手が\nおよんでいたと知った {var:1}た:
Learning Mordegon's reach extended even
to Phnom Nonh, the party renews its
resolve. With the Magic Key to unknown
lands, they set out again in search of orbs.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\n白の入り江に迷い込む。入り江を:
Searching for orbs, the party wanders into
a white cove, where the beautiful mermaid
Romia appears. She promised to marry a
human fisherman, Kinai, defying mermaid
law, and still waits for him.
tm.一行は ロミアに頼まれ キナイの様子を見てくる代わりに\n海底に沈んだオーブの:
At Romia's request, the party agrees to
look in on Kinai, and in return she'll take
them to the undersea kingdom to find the
sunken orb. They head for Lonalulu, Kinai's
home.

At Romia's request, the party agrees to
look in on Kinai, and in return she'll take
them to the undersea kingdom for the orb.
They visit Lonalulu, where he lives.
tm.そこで 一行は とある老婆と出会い\nこの村に残る伝承 人魚の呪いの紙芝居を見る:
The party meets an old woman and
watches the Mermaid's Curse play, about a
man whose soul a mermaid ate. She is
Kinai's mother, and says he has gone to
fight a giant squid.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\n人魚のロミアの頼みで 彼女と結:
Searching for orbs, the party comes to
Lonalulu at the mermaid Romia's request, to
find Kinai, the human fisherman she
promised to marry.
tm.そこで 一行は とある老婆と出会い\nこの村に残る伝承 人魚の呪いの紙芝居を見る:
The party meets an old woman and
watches the Mermaid's Curse play, about a
man whose soul was eaten by a mermaid.
Hearing from her, Kinai's mother, that he
went to fight a squid, they head to sea.
tm.ナギムナー村の船団を発見した 一行は\n突如現れ 船団を襲うクラーゴンと戦うこと:
The party finds Lonalulu's fleet attacked by
a kraken and fights it. After freeing the
fishermen, they are thanked and invited to
a victory feast in the village.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\n人魚のロミアの頼みで 彼女と結:
Searching for orbs, the party visits Lonalulu
to find Kinai. After saving the village's
fishermen from the kraken, they are invited
to the village feast.
tm.祝宴に参加していなかった キナイを探して\n村を散策する {var:1} ベロニ:
Searching the village for Kinai, who skipped
the feast, {var:1}, Veronica and Jade
find him on the pier. He has never heard of
Romia and says the one engaged to a
mermaid was his grandfather, Kinai Yuki.
tm.それは 人魚に魂を食われ 孤独に亡くなったという\nキナイ・ユキにまつわる 人魚:
It was the Mermaid's Curse tale of Kinai
Yuki, who died alone after a mermaid ate
his soul. Kinai asks {var:1} to meet him
at Silent Shore, as he has something to give
the mermaid.
tm.祝宴を抜けだし キナイを見つけた {var:1}たちは\n人魚と婚約したのは 彼:
Slipping away from the feast, the party
finds Kinai, who says it was his late
grandfather Kinai Yuki who was engaged to
a mermaid. He asks {var:1} to come to
Silent Shore, then leaves.
tm.しじまヶ浜を訪れた {var:1}に\nキナイは 祖父の形見である 約束のベール:
At Silent Shore, Kinai gives {var:1} his
grandfather's Promised veil to give to
Romia along with news of his death. The
party heads for the white cove to tell
Romia.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\n人魚のロミアの頼みで 彼女と結:
Searching for orbs, the party goes to
Lonalulu to find Kinai. {var:1} learns
from him that the mermaid's fiance was his
late grandfather, Kinai Yuki.
tm.キナイから 彼の祖父キナイ・ユキの形見である\n約束のベールをあずかった {va:
Carrying Kinai Yuki's Promised veil, the
party goes to the white cove to tell Romia
of her lover's death. She doesn't believe it
and asks to meet Kinai.
tm.{var:1}たちは キナイの頼みで ロミアに\nキナイ・ユキの形見を渡し その:
{var:1} gives Romia Kinai Yuki's
keepsake and tells her of his death, but she
doesn't believe it and wants to confirm it
herself. The party arranges for her to meet
Kinai at Silent Shore.
tm.人気のない しじまヶ浜で キナイと対峙したロミアは\nキナイ・ユキの墓を見て 恋:
At deserted Silent Shore, Romia faces Kinai
and, seeing Kinai Yuki's grave, accepts her
lover's death. She breaks mermaid law to
come ashore, wearing the veil, and bids him
farewell.
tm.陸に上がった人魚は\nふたたび 海に戻る時 泡となり消える……。\n人魚のおきて:
A mermaid who comes ashore turns to
foam on returning to the sea. As mermaid
law demands, Romia vanishes into foam.
Kinai, watching, runs to his grandfather's
hut as if remembering something.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nロミアが待つ婚約者のキナイは:
Searching for orbs, the party learns that
Romia's fiance was Kinai Yuki, the
fisherman Kinai's grandfather, who is long
dead. Romia cannot accept this and wants
to see for herself.
tm.人気のない しじまヶ浜で キナイと対峙したロミアは\nキナイ・ユキの墓を見て 恋:
At Silent Shore, Romia faces Kinai and,
seeing Kinai Yuki's grave, accepts her
lover's death, but breaking mermaid law
turns her to foam. Kinai runs to his
grandfather's hut.
tm.キナイ・ユキのアトリエに 残されていたのは\nロミアの姿が描かれた絵画と ロミア:
Kinai Yuki's studio holds a painting of Romia
and a letter telling how he could not go to
fetch her. Having read it, Kinai understands
his grandfather's feelings and murmurs that
he might fall in love too.
tm.人魚のロミアと 人間のキナイ・ユキ。\nふたりが 交わした 種族を超えた約束が\:
Romia the mermaid and Kinai Yuki the
human. The promise they made across
species could never be kept.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nロミアとキナイ・ユキの 種族を:
Searching for orbs, the party witnessed the
end of Romia and Kinai Yuki's love and
received the Mermaid harp at White Cove.
They sail for the undersea kingdom to find
the sunken orb.
tm.ロミアのおかげで手に入れた マーメイドハープを使い\n海底王国ムウレアにたどり着:
Using the Mermaid harp from Romia, the
party reaches Nautica and reports to
Queen Seren. As thanks for witnessing
Romia and Kinai's love, {var:1} receives
the Green orb from her.
tm.すべては 大樹の導きのもとに……。\nそう告げた 女王セレンに見送られ\nグリー:
All is guided by the Great Tree... Seen off by
Queen Seren, {var:1} and friends, now
with the Green orb, set out to find the next
orb.
tm.こうして すべてのオーブを集めた\n{var:1}たちは 命の大樹への道を開くた:
With every orb gathered, {var:1} and
friends head for the First Forest to open
the way to Yggdrasil.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nブルーオーブが 保管されている:
Searching for orbs, the party visits
Sniflheim, the beautiful snow city said to
keep the Blue orb. But the castle town and
its people are frozen in ice.
tm.{var:1}たちは 唯一 氷漬けの難を逃れた\nクレイモラン王国の女王 シャー:
{var:1} meets Charlotte, queen of
Sniflheim and the only one to escape being
frozen, who tells them a witch suddenly
appeared and froze the town and its
people.
tm.{var:1}たちは シャールから 魔女と手下の魔獣が\n東のシケスビア雪原の:
Charlotte says the witch and her beasts
are in Mirlean Forest on the Snaerfelt
snowfield to the east, where a foreign
rescue force has gone. The party heads
there to thaw Sniflheim.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\n美しき雪の都 クレイモラン王国:
Searching for orbs, the party visits the
beautiful snow city of Sniflheim, but it is
frozen. Learning from Queen Charlotte that
a witch is to blame, they head to Mirlean
Forest to defeat her.
tm.ミルレアンの森で 仲間とはぐれた {var:1}は\nクレイモランの救援に来た:
Separated from friends in Mirlean Forest,
{var:1} finds Hendrik, here to help
Sniflheim, fighting the witch's beast.
{var:1} defeats the beast, Mumbaba, but
the witch appears and attacks them both.
tm.しかし ふたりが氷漬けになる寸前 仲間たちが現れ\nベロニカの呪文で キズを負っ:
Just before they freeze, the others arrive
and Veronica's spell wounds the witch, who
flees. Hendrik, struck by her words, leaves,
and {var:1}, unconscious from the cold,
is carried to a nearby hut.
tm.ミルレアンの森で 仲間とはぐれた {var:1}は\nグレイグと戦っていた 魔女:
Separated from friends in Mirlean Forest,
{var:1} defeats the beast fighting
Hendrik, but the witch appears. Rescued by
the others, {var:1} escapes as the witch
flees and Hendrik leaves.
tm.寒さで意識を失った {var:1}は 仲間たちによって\n近くの小屋へ運ばれ そ:
{var:1} is carried to a hut and meets
Eckhart, who says the Ancient Library east
of Snaerfelt may hold a way to defeat the
witch. The party heads there.
tm.{var:1}は 森で 魔女の手下の魔獣を倒すが\nそこに魔女が現れ {var::
{var:1} defeats a beast in the forest,
but the witch attacks. Rescued by the
others, {var:1} meets Eckhart in a hut
and learns the Ancient Library may hold a
way to defeat the witch.
tm.古代図書館で発見した 魔女に関する古文書には\nミルレアンの森にいる獣は 魔獣で:
An old tome in the Ancient Library says the
beasts in Mirlean Forest are sacred beasts
needed to seal the witch, and that the
queen's book is the forbidden tome that
sealed her. The party returns to Sniflheim.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nクレイモラン王国を訪れるが 町:
Searching for orbs, the party visits frozen
Sniflheim. Hearing from Queen Charlotte
that a witch is to blame, they meet her in
Mirlean Forest, but she gets away.
tm.その後 {var:1}たちは\n古代図書館で 魔女に関する古文書を発見し\nその:
In the Ancient Library, the party finds an
old tome on the witch, and its account
makes them doubt Charlotte. Back in
Sniflheim, they confront her and the witch
Lizzlette reveals herself.
tm.{var:1}たちが 魔女を倒すと\n城下町の氷は溶け 町と住民は 元の姿を取り:
When {var:1} defeats the witch, the
town's ice melts. The real Charlotte, who
emerged from the forbidden tome, promises
the Blue orb as thanks, and the party heads
to the castle.
tm.その後 古文書の記述から シャールに疑いを持った\n一行が 彼女に詰めよると 魔:
Doubting Charlotte after the old tome, the
party confronts her and the witch reveals
herself. When defeated, the ice melts, and
the real Charlotte from the forbidden tome
promises the Blue orb.
tm.玉座の間では 禁書の中のシャールが 本物であると主張し\n一同は 混乱におちいる:
In the throne room, the Charlotte in the
book claims to be real, confusing everyone
until Eckhart's quick wit shows it is true.
Yet the freed Charlotte inexplicably
defends the witch.
tm.オーブを求め 旅を続ける {var:1}たちは\nクレイモラン王国を訪れるが 町:
Searching for orbs, the party visits frozen
Sniflheim. After defeating the witch posing
as Queen Charlotte, the ice melts and the
town and its people return to normal.
tm.お礼のオーブを受け取りに来た 玉座の間で\n{var:1}たちは また 魔女にダ:
In the throne room to collect the orb,
{var:1} nearly falls for the witch's trick
again, but Eckhart's quick wit exposes her.
The freed Charlotte inexplicably defends
the witch.
tm.女王は 相談相手になってくれた 魔女に恩義を感じており\n彼女にめんじて 魔女の:
The queen is grateful to the witch who
counseled her, so the witch is spared.
Touched by Charlotte's kindness, she
confesses why she froze the town, and the
party receives the Blue orb.
tm.すべてのオーブを集めた\n{var:1}たちは 命の大樹への道を開くため\nシケ:
With every orb gathered, {var:1} and
friends head east through Snaerfelt to the
First Forest to open the way to Yggdrasil.
tm.女王は 相談相手になってくれた 魔女に恩義を感じており\n彼女にめんじて 魔女の:
The queen is grateful to the witch who
counseled her, so the witch is spared.
Touched by Charlotte's kindness, she
confesses why she froze the town, and the
party receives the Blue orb.
tm.{var:1}たちは 玉座の間で ふたたび\n魔女にダマされそうになるが エッケ:
In the throne room, {var:1} nearly falls
for the witch's trick again, but Eckhart's
quick wit exposes her and she repents. The
matter settled, the party receives the Blue
orb from the queen.

In the throne room, {var:1} nearly falls
for the witch's trick again, but Eckhart's
quick wit exposes her and she repents. The
matter settled, the party receives the Blue
orb.
tm.命の大樹への道を開くため ６つのオーブ探しの旅に出た\n{var:1}たちは 聖:
Searching for the six orbs to open the way
to Yggdrasil, the party reaches Arboria.
Elder Fanard welcomes them and says to
come to the Great Cathedral once all six
orbs are gathered.

Searching for the six orbs to open the way
to Yggdrasil, the party reaches Arboria.
Welcomed by Elder Fanard, they hear the
myth of Yggdrasil and the Luminary's
legend.
tm.神話によると 勇者とは 世界に災厄が訪れる時\n大樹に選ばれて生まれる存在で 命:
The myth says the Luminary is chosen by
the Great Tree and born when disaster
threatens, and Yggdrasil is the source of all
life in Erdrea. {var:1} was born to defeat
Mordegon.
tm.勇者ローシュの神話を聞いた {var:1}たちは\n命の大樹に眠るという 闇をは:
Having heard the myth of Erdwin, the
Luminary, {var:1} and friends cross the
First Forest toward Yggdrasil to gain the
power to dispel darkness.
tm.神話によると 勇者とは 世界に災厄が訪れる時\n大樹に選ばれ生まれる存在で 命の:
The myth says the Luminary is chosen by
the Great Tree and born when disaster
threatens, and Yggdrasil is the source of all
life in Erdrea. Resting en route, the party
vows again to defeat Mordegon.
tm.始祖の森を進んだ一行が 山頂にある祭壇に\n６つのオーブを捧げると 虹の橋が現れ:
Through the First Forest, the party offers
the six orbs at the altar on the summit and
a rainbow bridge appears. {var:1} and
friends cross it to Yggdrasil to gain the
power to defeat Mordegon.
tm.６つのオーブのチカラで現れた 虹の橋を渡り\n命の大樹へ たどり着いた {var:
Crossing the rainbow bridge to Yggdrasil,
{var:1} tries to take the Luminary's
sword from the Great Tree's soul, but
General Jasper appears, wreathed in dark
aura, and defeats the party.
tm.そこに グレイグ将軍が デルカダール王と共に現れる。\nホメロスの闇のチカラを見:
General Hendrik arrives with the King of
Heliodor. Seeing Jasper's dark power,
Hendrik tells the king that Jasper is a
monster's lackey and goes to strike him, but
the king cuts him down from behind.
tm.そして デルカダール王が正体を現す。\n……その正体は ウルノーガ。\nウルノー:
Then the King of Heliodor reveals himself
as Mordegon. He steals {var:1}'s
Luminary power, turns the Luminary's sword
into the Sword of Shadows, takes the tree's
soul, and is born as the Dark One.
tm.魔王が誕生した後 {var:1}は\n薄れゆく意識の中で 幼い頃の夢を見る。\n:
After Mordegon's birth, {var:1} dreams
of childhood as consciousness fades. At
the end of the dream, {var:1} hears an
eerie voice and wakes.
tm.目を覚ました場所は 海底王国ムウレアであり\n{var:1}は 魚の姿になってい:
{var:1} wakes in the undersea kingdom
of Nautica, transformed into a fish. At the
palace, Queen Seren explains she turned
{var:1} into a fish to fool Mordegon's
eyes.
tm.眠り続けていた間に この世界で\n起きたことを知りたければ あとをついてくるよう:
Queen Seren tells {var:1} to follow her if
{var:1} wants to know what happened in
the world during the long sleep, and swims
through a door deep in the palace.
tm.魔王が誕生した後 海底王国ムウレアで目を覚ました\n{var:1}は 魔王の目を:
After Mordegon's birth, {var:1} woke in
Nautica as a fish, by Queen Seren's design
to fool Mordegon. To learn what is
happening in the world, {var:1} follows
her deeper into the palace.
tm.女王セレンを追う {var:1}が たどり着いたのは\n守り人の海という 神聖な:
Following Queen Seren, {var:1} arrives
at the sacred Sea of the Guardians. Seren
says the royal treasure, the Far-Sight Pearl,
can carry a soul on rain to see the surface,
and urges {var:1} to touch it.
tm.魔王が誕生した後 海底王国ムウレアで目を覚ました\n{var:1}は 魔王の目を:
After Mordegon's birth, {var:1} woke in
Nautica as a fish by Queen Seren's design.
Led to the Sea of the Guardians, {var:1}
uses the Far-Sight Pearl to see the
surface.
tm.魔王ウルノーガによって 豊かなロトゼタシアは死に\n生命の源たる 命の大樹は 無:
Mordegon has killed lush Erdrea, and
Yggdrasil, the source of life, has fallen to
the ground. Yet Seren, who saw a man
helping people in the despair, tells
{var:1} there is still hope.
tm.最後に 女王セレンが {var:1}に見せたのは\nまがまがしく空に浮かぶ 天空:
Last, Seren shows {var:1} the Fortress
of Fear floating in the sky and Mordegon's
minions about to attack Nautica. She says
the barrier will soon shatter and monsters
will swallow the kingdom.
tm.海底王国に戻った {var:1}は\n女王セレンから 進むべき道を教えられる。\:
Back in Nautica, {var:1} is told the path
ahead: a flame of hope that brings light to
the world is with {var:1}'s companions,
and where it shines lies the right path.
tm.そこへ 魔王の配下である 巨大な魔物が\n海底王国の結界を破壊し 攻めこんでくる:
Then a giant monster in Mordegon's service
smashes the barrier and attacks. "A
Luminary is one who never gives up," says
Seren, and sends {var:1} off to safety
on a current she conjures.
tm.魔王誕生の後 海底王国ムウレアで 魚の姿となって\n目を覚ました {var:1}:
After Mordegon's birth, {var:1} wakes as
a fish in Nautica and escapes the monster
attacking it with Seren's help. Hooked by
the fisherman Arani, {var:1} returns to
human form as the spell breaks.
tm.{var:1}を釣りあげた 漁師アラーニは\n{var:1}の ただごとではない:
Seeing {var:1}'s state, the fisherman
Arani, who hooked {var:1}, senses
something grave. He tells {var:1} of the
Last Bastion, where a hero is said to give
everyone hope.
tm.世界をまわり 仲間を集め 希望の炎を灯す……。\n王国から逃げた際に 女王セレン:
Gather allies around the world and kindle
the flame of hope... Shown this path by
Seren, {var:1} aims for the Last Bastion.
At Arani's suggestion, {var:1} rests for
the night in a hut on the Emerald Coast.
tm.仲間を探す旅に出た {var:1}は 小屋を出て\nデルカコスタ地方に出るが 空:
{var:1} leaves the hut onto the Emerald
Coast to find the sky pitch black. Arani says
that since the terrible explosion, eerie
darkness has seeped from Heliodor Castle
and morning no longer comes.
tm.アラーニと別れ ひとり 最後の砦を目指すこととなった\n{var:1}がたどりつ:
Parting with Arani, {var:1} heads alone
for the Last Bastion and arrives in
Cobblestone, now a fortress where people
of Heliodor gather. {var:1} reunites with
Gemma and Amber.
tm.ふたりの話によると ホメロス将軍に 村を焼かれた際\n住人たちは ある人物に助け:
They say that when Jasper burned the
village, someone saved the villagers and
later led them to the Last Bastion. Amber
says the King of Heliodor is here too and
urges {var:1} to see him.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 最後の砦を訪れた {var:1}は\n母ペルラにうながされ:
At Amber's urging, {var:1} visits the King
of Heliodor's tent. The king apologises for
all he did and says he remembers nothing of
Mordegon's possession, when a soldier
reports the hero's return.
tm.兵士の報告を聞いた デルカダール王に うながされ\n英雄を出迎えるため {var:
At the king's urging, {var:1} goes to
greet the hero and meets General Hendrik
again. Hendrik reports odd monster
movements, orders the bastion's people to
prepare for battle, and heads outside.
tm.{var:1}は グレイグの様子を案じる\nデルカダール王に 最後の砦を 魔物の:
Worried about Hendrik, the King of Heliodor
asks {var:1} to fight beside him to
defend the Last Bastion from the monsters'
assault.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 最後の砦を訪れた {var:1}は\n魔物の襲撃から 砦を守:
{var:1} visits the Last Bastion and joins
Hendrik's soldiers to defend it from the
monsters. They prepare to meet the army
advancing on the fortress.
tm.魔物の軍勢と戦う {var:1}と グレイグの前に\n師団長が立ちはだかるが ふ:
Fighting the monster army, {var:1} and
Hendrik face a commander. When they
defeat him, the leaderless monsters flee. A
messenger then summons {var:1} and
Hendrik to the king's tent.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 最後の砦を訪れた {var:1}は\n魔物の襲撃から 砦を守:
{var:1} visits the Last Bastion and joins
Hendrik's soldiers to repel and defeat the
monster army. A messenger then summons
{var:1} and Hendrik to the king's tent.
tm.テントを訪れた {var:1}に 王は\n常闇を生む魔物を倒し 空をおおう闇を晴:
At the tent, the king asks {var:1} and
Hendrik to slip into Heliodor Castle and
defeat the monster spawning eternal
darkness. Hendrik hesitates to leave the
bastion but, at the king's words, agrees.
tm.デルカダール王の計らいで 休息をとった {var:1}は\n空をおおう闇を晴らす:
Rested thanks to the king, {var:1} sets
out with Hendrik for Heliodor Castle, now a
monster den, to dispel the darkness
covering the sky.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 最後の砦を訪れた {var:1}は\nデルカダール王と 将軍:
{var:1} meets the King of Heliodor and
Hendrik again at the Last Bastion. At the
king's request, {var:1} and Hendrik head
for Heliodor Castle to defeat the monster
spawning eternal darkness.
tm.デルカダール城への潜入のため 地下水路へつながる\n崖を登った {var:1}と:
{var:1} and Hendrik climb the cliff to the
castle's sewers and see monsters flying
toward the Last Bastion. Uneasy but
trusting those left behind, they slip into
Heliodor Castle.
tm.デルカダール城内の階段が 破壊されているのを見て\n魔物が上階の玉座の間にいると:
Seeing the castle stairs destroyed, Hendrik
guesses the monster is in the throne room
above, so they seek another way up.
Visions in the courtyard tree's roots recall a
secret passage from his boyhood.
tm.城への潜入に成功し 上階にある 玉座の間を目指す\n{var:1}とグレイグは:
Heading for the throne room, {var:1}
and Hendrik find the secret passage using
Hendrik's memory from the courtyard tree.
Before going up, Hendrik apologises for his
past rudeness and renews his resolve.
tm.玉座の間に着いた ふたりを 待ちうけていたのは\n魔王のチカラにより 魔軍司令と:
In the throne room, Jasper, made Dark
Marshal by Mordegon's power, awaits.
Hendrik falls to one knee at his attack, but
says he has found his reason to fight: to be
the Luminary's shield. He rises and charges.
tm.しかし グレイグの攻撃は当たらず ホメロスは\nそんなグレイグの様子をあざけり笑:
But Hendrik's attacks miss, and Jasper
mocks him and vanishes. Left behind, the
two defeat Zordrak, the Corpse General,
one of the six generals, and lift the
darkness covering Heliodor's sky.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 最後の砦を訪れた {var:1}は\nグレイグと共に デルカ:
{var:1} and Hendrik slip into Heliodor
Castle and defeat Zordrak, the Corpse
General who spawned eternal darkness.
Having cleared Heliodor's sky, they head
back to the Last Bastion.
tm.{var:1}とグレイグが 最後の砦にたどりつくと\n魔物から隠れていた 砦の民:
At the Last Bastion, people hiding from
monsters greet {var:1} and Hendrik with
Heliodorian flags. In the circle of joy,
Hendrik vows to join {var:1} and fight
alongside.
tm.こうして 太陽を取り戻した 最後の砦の祝宴は\n一昼夜続き 山間の砦に\nたえ間:
So began a feast at the Last Bastion for
the regained sun. It lasted a day and a
night, and songs of joy rang through the
mountains without pause... Then the night
ended.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 最後の砦を訪れた {var:1}は\nデルカダール王の願いを:
{var:1} visits the Last Bastion, and at
the king's request defeats the monster
spawning eternal darkness with Hendrik.
After a day-long victory feast, they are
called to the king's tent.
tm.王のテントで 王は 旅立つグレイグに\nデルカダール最高の騎士の証である\nデル:
In the tent, the king gives Hendrik the
Heliodor shield, the mark of Heliodor's finest
knight, and wishes him well. He advises
{var:1} to seek help against Mordegon
at Mount Pang Lai, tied to the Luminary.
tm.こうして グレイグという 新たな仲間を得た\n{var:1}は 仲間たちを探すた:
With Hendrik as a new companion,
{var:1} sets out for Mount Pang Lai, tied
to the Luminary, to find the other allies.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 {var:1}たちは\n勇者にゆかりある者が住むという ドゥ:
Seeking allies, {var:1} visits Angri-La,
said to be home to those tied to the
Luminary. Young High Priest Sampo sees at
once that {var:1} is the Luminary and
invites the party to the Master's palace.
tm.大師の宮殿を訪れた {var:1}は 大僧正から\nユグノア王子は 幼子の頃に:
At the palace, the High Priest says
Dundrasil's princes trained here as children,
and {var:1} should have too. Master
Nima, {var:1}'s would-be teacher, died
shielding the village from Mordegon's birth.
tm.その後 サンポ大僧正は\n{var:1}たちに 見せたい場所があると言い\n一行:
Afterward, High Priest Sampo says he has
somewhere to show {var:1} and leads
the party to the Great Training Ground
behind the palace.
tm.その後 一行は 伝説の勇者ローシュと\n仲間の魔法使いウラノスが ドゥルダの大修:
The party hears the legend that the
Luminary Erdwin and his mage companion
Uranos trained together at Angri-La's
training ground. They accept the High
Priest's invitation and step inside.
tm.ロウを始め 歴代のユグノア王子が修行をしたという\nドゥルダの大修練場を見学した:
After touring the training ground where
Dundrasil's princes, Rab among them,
trained, the party joins a feast for
{var:1}. With no clue to defeat
Mordegon found, they prepare to leave.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 {var:1}たちは\n勇者にゆかりある者が住むという ドゥ:
Seeking allies, {var:1} visits Angri-La,
home of those tied to the Luminary. The
party learns the history of Dundrasil and
Angri-La and that Master Nima, {var:1}'s
would-be teacher, gave his life to protect it.
tm.ロウを始め 歴代のユグノア王子が修行をしたという\nドゥルダの大修練場を見学した:
After touring the training ground where
Dundrasil's princes, Rab among them,
trained, the party joins a feast for
{var:1}. Leaving the palace, they find
High Priest Sampo and others gathered.
tm.僧たちの話から {var:1}たちは 半月ほど前に\nドゥーランダ山頂へ向かった:
From the monks, {var:1} hears of a
mysterious trainee who went up Mount
Pang Lai's summit half a month ago. With
the High Priest, the party heads to the
summit to help the trainee.
tm.ロウを始め 歴代のユグノア王子が修行したという\nドゥルダの大修練場を見学した:
After touring the training ground where
Dundrasil's princes, Rab among them,
trained, the party hears from High Priest
Sampo of a mysterious trainee who went up
Mount Pang Lai. They go to the summit.
tm.山頂で 瀕死の修行者を発見した 一行は\n所持品から その修行者こそ ロウだと知:
At the summit, the party finds a dying
trainee, and his belongings reveal it is Rab.
The High Priest says Rab might be saved in
the Underworld, between life and death, so
{var:1} goes alone.
tm.その後 {var:1}たちは 謎の修行者を助けるため\nサンポ大僧正と共に ドゥ:
The party and High Priest Sampo climb
Mount Pang Lai's summit to help the trainee
and find Rab dying. Told Rab might be
saved in the Underworld, {var:1} goes
there alone.
tm.{var:1}が 大僧正の分霊の儀式で 冥府に向かうと\nそこは 真っ暗闇の 虚:
{var:1} goes to the Underworld through
the High Priest's soul-splitting rite and finds
a pitch-black void. Suddenly a light appears
and a single building looms ahead.
tm.その後 {var:1}たちは 謎の修行者を助けるため\nサンポ大僧正と共に ドゥ:
The party and High Priest Sampo climb the
summit to help the trainee and find Rab
dying. When {var:1} goes to the
Underworld to save him, a building like the
Great Training Ground appears.
tm.{var:1}が 奥に進むと そこには\nひとりの女性がおり 命の大樹がなくなっ:
Going deeper, {var:1} meets a woman
who says the Underworld has become a
total void now that Yggdrasil is gone. She
vanishes, leaving a cryptic remark that
someone is trying to defy Mordegon.
tm.その後 {var:1}たちは 謎の修行者を助けるため\nドゥーランダ山頂へ行き:
The party climbs the summit and finds Rab
dying. When {var:1} goes to the
Underworld to save him, a building like the
Great Training Ground appears, where Rab
trains under Master Nima.
tm.ロウは 踊りながら大樹の紋様を描く修行をこなし\nドゥルダの奥義 グランドクロス:
Rab masters the Angri-La secret art Grand
Cross by dancing and tracing the Tree's
pattern. Delighted, he and {var:1} start
to leave, but Master Nima says {var:1}'s
training is not yet finished.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 ドゥルダ郷を訪れた\n{var:1}たちは サンポ大僧正から:
Seeking allies, {var:1} visits Angri-La
and hears Dundrasil and Angri-La's history
from High Priest Sampo. Then the party
climbs Mount Pang Lai's summit and finds
Rab dying.
tm.{var:1}が ロウを助けるために 冥府に向かうと\nそこには 師匠のニマ大師:
In the Underworld, {var:1} finds Rab
training under Master Nima. After Rab
masters Grand Cross, {var:1} learns
Erdwin's Overlord Slash by fighting Rab,
who has received Nima's power.
tm.{var:1}はロウとの戦いに勝利し 覇王斬を習得するが\nそこに 魔王ウルノー:
{var:1} defeats Rab and masters
Overlord Slash, but Mordegon attacks.
Guided by Master Nima, {var:1} and Rab
unleash Grand Nebula, repel him and
escape the Underworld.
tm.{var:1}が ロウを助けるために 冥府に向かうと\nそこには 師匠のニマ大師:
In the Underworld, {var:1} finds Rab
training under Master Nima. After Rab
masters Grand Cross, {var:1} challenges
him and wins, mastering Overlord Slash.
tm.そこに 魔王ウルノーガが 攻撃を仕掛けてくるが\n{var:1}とロウは グラン:
Mordegon attacks, but {var:1} and Rab
unleash Grand Nebula, repel him and return
safely. With Rab in the party, they head to
Arboria to follow Erdwin's footsteps while
seeking allies.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 シルビアが率いるパレードと出会った\n{var:1}たちは:
Seeking allies, {var:1} meets Sylvando's
parade and learns he parades across the
land to bring light to the world. They lead
the parade to Phnom Nonh to escort a
villager, Bahatra.
tm.プチャラオ村まで バハトラを送り届けた一行は\n魔王の手下 フールフールにだまさ:
At Phnom Nonh, the party learns the
villagers' treasures were taken by the
Mordegon lackey Furfur's deception.
Leading the parade, they head south of the
village to get the treasures back.
tm.その道中 一行は チェロンというバハトラの息子と出会い\n彼から 父を見返すため:
On the way, they meet Bahatra's son
Chelon, who followed the monsters alone to
retrieve his father's treasure and prove
himself. With Chelon in the parade, they
head for Furfur's lair.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 シルビアの世助けパレードと出会った\n{var:1}たちは:
Seeking allies, {var:1} meets Sylvando's
parade and escorts a villager, Bahatra, to
Phnom Nonh. Learning the Mordegon lackey
Furfur tricked the villagers out of their
treasures, they head for his lair.
tm.バハトラの息子 チェロンをパレードに加えた一行は\nフールフールを打ち倒し さら:
With Bahatra's son Chelon in the parade,
the party defeats Furfur and rescues the
villagers, but Bahatra's treasure, his late
wife's keepsake, is shattered. Sylvando
comforts Chelon and they head home.
tm.一行が バハトラの家を訪れると 親子の再会があり\nバハトラの大切なモノは チェ:
At Bahatra's house, father and son reunite,
and it turns out Bahatra's real treasure was
Chelon himself, not the broken keepsake.
As the rift mends, Sylvando walks away for
some reason.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 シルビアの世助けパレードと出会った\n{var:1}たちは:
Seeking allies, {var:1} meets Sylvando's
parade and visits Phnom Nonh. The party
defeats Furfur, who tricked the villagers,
saving the village and mending the rift
between Bahatra and Chelon.
tm.村が救われ 魔王を倒す旅に ふたたび加わりたいという\nシルビアだが その前に:
Sylvando wants to rejoin the quest to
defeat Mordegon, but first wants to leave
his troupe with someone he trusts. He asks
{var:1} to come along, then goes
outside the village to tell the troupe.
tm.シルビアは 世助けパレードの解散を宣言すると\nナカマたちを預ける 信頼できる人:
Sylvando announces the parade's
disbandment and reveals the trustworthy
person is his father, Diego, whom he hasn't
seen in over a decade. {var:1} follows
him to his hometown, Puerto Valor.
tm.村が救われ シルビアは 魔王を倒す旅に加わるべく\nパレードのナカマたちを 預け:
With the village saved, Sylvando heads to
his father Diego, unseen for over a decade,
to leave his troupe and join the quest
against Mordegon. At Puerto Valor, he asks
{var:1} to go ahead to Diego's mansion.
tm.仲間を探す旅の途中 シルビアの世助けパレードと出会った\n{var:1}たちは:
Seeking allies, {var:1} meets Sylvando's
parade, saves Phnom Nonh by defeating
Furfur, and mends a family rift. Now
Sylvando heads to Puerto Valor to leave his
troupe and join the fight.
tm.シルビアから 先に屋敷へ行くように言われた一行は\nシルビアの父である ジエーゴ:
Sent ahead to the mansion, the party meets
Diego, Sylvando's father. Hendrik, who
trained as a knight under Diego, enjoys the
reunion, but Sylvando is missing, so
{var:1} goes back to town to find him.
tm.ソルティコの浜辺で {var:1}は シルビアから\n騎士の名家の跡継ぎという身:
On Puerto Valor's beach, {var:1} hears
that Sylvando, heir to a noble knightly
house, told his father he'd train as a
performer and ran away. Resolved to see
his father, he goes with {var:1} to Diego.
tm.ソルティコの町に着いた {var:1}は\n父であるジエーゴに会うと決心した シ:
{var:1} brings Sylvando, resolved to see
his father, to Diego's room. But Diego
accepted long ago that Sylvando would
follow his dream, and their years-long rift is
mended.
tm.シルビアは 必ず魔王を倒し 町に帰ってくると誓い\n父であるジエーゴのもとに あ:
Sylvando vows to defeat Mordegon and
return, and tearfully parts with the troupe
left with Diego. With Sylvando back in the
party, they resume the search for allies.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\nシルビアの船で 大海原:
Heading for Arboria, the party sails off on
Sylvando's ship when Jarvis, one of
Mordegon's six generals, appears. Rab's
Grand Cross fails, and Jarvis's attack
throws {var:1} into the sea.
tm.……海に落ちたはずの {var:1}であったが\n目を開けると 見知らぬ草原が:
...{var:1} fell into the sea, yet wakes to
find a vast, unfamiliar meadow.

...{var:1} fell into the sea, yet wakes to
find a vast, unfamiliar meadow. A strange
figure on a house roof, calling himself a
Seer, fishes with {var:1} and goes back
inside.

...{var:1} fell into the sea, yet wakes to
find a vast, unfamiliar meadow. The strange
figure there, a Seer, tells {var:1} that
the Luminary's power is too tough to be
crushed by Mordegon.
tm.最後に預言者から 世界を救えと言われ ふと気づくと\n{var:1}は 海岸にお:
Told by the Seer to save the world,
{var:1} finds himself on a beach, where
friends say Jarvis was escaped by miracle.
Glowing letters appear: "Courage in your
heart, thunder in your hand."
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n大海原に旅立つが 魔王:
Heading for Arboria, {var:1} sails out,
but Mordegon's general Jarvis throws
{var:1} into the sea alone. Waking in a
strange space, {var:1} is told by a Seer
that the Luminary's power is not lost.
tm.最後に預言者から 世界を救えと言われ ふと気づくと\n{var:1}は 現実世界:
Told by the Seer to save the world,
{var:1} wakes on a real beach. Then
glowing letters appear over the night sea:
"Courage in your heart, thunder in your
hand."
tm.ユグノア城跡で 勇者のチカラを取り戻した\n{var:1}は ふたたび ジャコラ:
Having regained the Luminary's power at
Dundrasil Ruins, {var:1} faces Jarvis
again. As {var:1}'s hand glows and the
crest is raised high, lightning strikes Jarvis
and breaks his protective spell.
tm.激しい戦いの末 魔王の配下 ジャコラを倒し\n海の脅威を取り除いた {var:1:
After a fierce battle, {var:1} defeats
Mordegon's general Jarvis and removes the
threat on the sea. The party resumes its
search for allies.
tm.魔王を倒す旅の途中 {var:1}たちは\nサマディー王国で 落ちてきた 勇者の:
On the quest against Mordegon, {var:1}
sees the Luminary's star fall in Gallopolis.
Rab tells its myth: Erdwin, who defeated the
dark god, rose to the heavens as a star to
watch over Erdrea.
tm.王に話を聞くため サマディー城を訪れると そこには\nバクラバ砂丘へと旅立つ フ:
At Gallopolis Castle, the party finds Prince
Faris leaving for Bakraba Dunes. The king
says he found ancient writing on the
Luminary's star, and {var:1} follows him
there to investigate.
tm.王に話を聞こうと サマディー城を訪れた一行は\nファーリス王子が 勇者の星に刻ま:
At Gallopolis Castle, the party learns Prince
Faris has gone to Bakraba Dunes to study
ancient writing on the Luminary's star.
{var:1} heads there to investigate the
star and check on the prince.
tm.バクラバ砂丘の関所で 王子に追いつき\n王子は {var:1}たちとの再会をよろ:
At the Bakraba Dunes checkpoint, the party
catches up with Prince Faris, who is glad to
see them. Rab then decodes the ancient
writing while {var:1} heads for the ruins
beneath the star at the dunes' center.
tm.バクラバ砂丘の関所で 王子と再会した一行は\n星の真下にある 遺跡に到着し\nど:
Reunited with Faris at the checkpoint, the
party reaches the ruins beneath the star,
and a black spirit appears from nowhere. As
all gaze at the giant star, Rab begins
decoding the writing.
tm.魔王を倒す旅の途中 サマディー王国を訪れた\n{var:1}たちは 勇者の星に刻:
On the quest against Mordegon, {var:1}
visits Gallopolis and learns Prince Faris has
gone to study the star's ancient writing.
{var:1} heads to Bakraba Dunes to
investigate and check on him.
tm.星の調査に向かった {var:1}たちは\n王子と再会した後 星の真下にある 遺:
At the ruins beneath the star, the
Luminary's star reacts to the black spirit
and suddenly plunges toward the ground.
Rab succeeds in deciphering the word
"Calasmos."
tm.そこへ飛来して現れた謎の剣士が 勇者の星を一刀両断し\n星が消滅したことを確認す:
A mysterious swordsman swoops in, cuts
the star in two, confirms its destruction,
and leaves. Puzzled, {var:1} returns to
Gallopolis Castle to learn what "Calasmos"
means.
tm.星の調査に向かった {var:1}たちは\n王子と再会した後 星の真下にある 遺:
At the ruins beneath the star, the
Luminary's star suddenly plunges to earth.
Rab deciphers the word "Calasmos," and a
mysterious swordsman destroys the star.
tm.{var:1}たちは 星に刻まれた\nニズゼルファという言葉の意味を知るため 城:
{var:1} returns to the castle to learn
what "Calasmos" means, but the king knows
nothing. The mystery remains, but Gallopolis
is spared, and the party resumes the quest
to defeat Mordegon.
tm.{var:1}たちに 星に刻まれた\nニズゼルファという言葉の意味を 突きとめる:
The party couldn't learn what "Calasmos"
means. The mystery remains, but Gallopolis
is spared. The king gives them Gaia's
hammer, needed to forge the Luminary's
sword, and the party resumes its journey.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\nネルセンの宿屋を訪れ\:
Heading for Arboria while seeking allies,
{var:1} visits Warrior's Rest Inn and has
a strange dream of a warrior lamenting his
regret.
tm.夢の中に出てきた 戦士の甲冑に描かれた紋章が\nユグノアのものだったと聞かされた:
{var:1} learns the crest on the warrior's
armour in the dream was Dundrasil's. On
Rab's lead, {var:1} heads to Dundrasil
Ruins.
tm.夢の中に出てきた 戦士の正体をつかむため\nユグノア城跡を訪れた 一行は\nロウ:
To find the warrior's identity, the party
visits Dundrasil Ruins and, led by Rab, finds
an entrance to an underground passage.
They descend the stairs in search of the
warrior.
tm.夢の中に出てきた 戦士の正体をつかむため\nユグノア城跡を訪れた 一行は\n 地:
To find the warrior's identity, the party
visits Dundrasil Ruins and sees the warrior
from the dream deep in the passage. He
cries out in lament and suddenly attacks.
tm.嘆きの戦士を倒すと あたりに 夢で聞いた声が響き\n戦士の正体が {var:1}:
When the grieving warrior falls, a voice
from the dream echoes and he is revealed
to be {var:1}'s father, King Irwin of
Dundrasil. The party vows to save Irwin
from despair.
tm.夢の中に出てきた 戦士の正体をつかむため\nユグノア城跡を訪れた 一行は\n地下:
To find the warrior's identity, the party
visits Dundrasil Ruins and sees the warrior
from the dream deep in the passage.
{var:1} learns he is {var:1}'s father,
Irwin.
tm.アーウィンを救うため 嘆きの戦士に近づいた\n{var:1}は 邪悪な声に いざ:
Approaching the grieving warrior to save
Irwin, {var:1} is lured by an evil voice
and dragged into the darkness within him.
The world there is Dundrasil sixteen years
ago.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n嘆きの戦士と化した 父:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} meets Irwin, now a Grieving
Warrior. To save his father from despair,
{var:1} enters Irwin's memories, to
Dundrasil sixteen years ago.
tm.１６年前の ユグノア王国は\n勇者 {var:1}の誕生を祝う宴の 真っ只中。\:
Sixteen years ago, Dundrasil is in the midst
of a feast celebrating the Luminary's birth.
Behind it, Irwin is gathering the kings for a
vital Council of Four Nations about the
Luminary.
tm.城の中庭にいた デルカダール王とロウに\nアーウィンは 勇者は 希望の光だと告げ:
In the castle courtyard, Irwin tells King
Carnelian and Rab the Luminary is a light of
hope, but Carnelian cuts him off and leaves.
Tense, {var:1} follows Irwin to Eleonor's
room.
tm.勇者を 会議に連れていくため 王妃エレノアと\n幼いマルティナのもとを訪れた ア:
To bring the Luminary to the council, Irwin
visits Queen Eleonor and little Jade. As a
sudden storm frightens Eleonor, Irwin vows
to protect her, takes baby {var:1} and
heads to the council.
tm.そこで行われた 四大国会議で 王たちは\n勇者の光に 邪悪な闇が引き寄せられるの:
At the Council of Four Nations, the kings
argue fiercely that the Luminary's light
draws evil darkness. But Irwin insists that
light is a beacon of hope that drives the
darkness away.
tm.アーウィンの言葉に胸を打たれた 各国の王たちは\n{var:1}を 全力で守って:
Moved by Irwin's words, the kings swear to
protect {var:1} with all their might, and
the council ends. Then a soldier rushes in
with news that monsters are attacking the
castle.
tm.そこで行われた 四大国会議で 王たちは\n心をひとつにし 勇者 {var:1}を:
There, the kings unite and swear to protect
the Luminary {var:1} with all their might.
But right after, a horde of monsters hunting
the Luminary pours into Dundrasil.
tm.デルカダール王とロウが 魔物を退ける間に\n赤ん坊の {var:1}を守り 走る:
While Carnelian and Rab hold the monsters
back, Irwin runs with baby {var:1}. He
meets Eleonor and Jade, prepares, and
tries to flee the castle.
tm.城の周りを魔物に囲まれ\n正門から外に出られないと悟った アーウィンは\n秘密の:
With monsters surrounding the castle, Irwin
realizes the main gate is unusable and
recalls a secret underground passage. He
leads Eleonor and Jade down the stairs
from the storeroom.
tm.エレノアと マルティナを連れ\n城の外へ逃げだそうとした アーウィンだったが\n:
Irwin tries to take Eleonor and Jade out of
the castle, but a monster pack catches up
in the passage. He lets the two escape and
faces the monsters alone.
tm.エレノアと マルティナを 城の外へ逃がし\n魔物の群れを撃退した アーウィンは\:
After getting Eleonor and Jade out, Irwin
beats back the monsters and hears King
Carnelian calling for Jade. He hurries to the
king to tell him she is safe.
tm.そこで {var:1}が見たのは\nデルカダール王に取り憑き 父 アーウィンを\:
There, {var:1} sees the sorcerer
Mordegon, who possessed King Carnelian
and killed Irwin. Learning the truth of
sixteen years ago, {var:1} meets
Bakumos, the evil that darkened Irwin.
tm.一度は バクーモスの放つ闇に 囚われかけた\n{var:1}であったが どこから:
Bakumos's darkness nearly takes
{var:1}, but a mysterious voice restores
the Luminary's light and saves the day.
Back in reality, {var:1} and friends
challenge Bakumos.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}は\n嘆きの戦士と化した 父 ア:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} enters Irwin's memories of
Dundrasil sixteen years ago to save the
Grieving Warrior, his father, and learns
Mordegon schemed behind the tragedy.
tm.現実に戻った {var:1}が\n父を嘆きの戦士へと変えた バクーモスを撃破する:
Back in reality, {var:1} defeats Bakumos,
who turned his father into a Grieving
Warrior. Irwin regains his senses and
ascends to heaven with Eleonor, the voice
that has guided {var:1}.
tm.その直後 {var:1}の手のアザが光り輝き\n勇者のチカラが ふたたび 湧きお:
Then the mark on {var:1}'s hand glows,
and the Luminary's power surges anew.
Knowing the truth of sixteen years ago,
{var:1} resolves to defeat Mordegon
and resumes the search for allies.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す旅の途中\nマルティナのウワサを聞いた {var:
On the way to Arboria, hearing rumors of
Jade, {var:1} and friends visit
Octagonia, now a monster casino ruled by
Spirit General Boogie.
tm.{var:1}たちは マルティナを探すため\n番人のドラキーに ラブリーエキスを:
To find Jade, {var:1} gives the Dracky
guard a Lovely extract and heads to the
Special Roulette Stage, said to be only for
VIP guests.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す旅の途中\nマルティナのウワサを聞いた {var:
Hearing rumors of Jade on the way to
Arboria, {var:1} visits Octagonia, now a
monster casino. There they find Jade, but
Boogie has turned her into a monster.
tm.魔物化した マルティナの襲撃を止めると\nついに 黒幕である ブギーが姿を現す。:
After stopping the monster-turned Jade,
the mastermind Boogie appears. {var:1}
defeats him, those who were turned back
into humans, and Octagonia is freed from
monsters.
tm.魔物化していたことで 新たなチカラに目覚めた\nマルティナは 旅の途中で見つけた:
Awakened to new power by her monster
form, Jade hands {var:1} the Mermaid
harp she found on her travels and rejoins
the party. The group resumes the search
for allies.
tm.魔王を倒す旅の途中 {var:1}たちが訪れた\nホムラの里では 化け物のウワサ:
On the quest to defeat the Dark One,
{var:1} visits Hotto, where rumors of a
monster abound. The priestess Miko cannot
hold the fire rite, so {var:1} sets off for
Mount Huji.

On the quest to defeat the Dark One,
{var:1} visits Hotto, where rumors of a
monster abound. Asked by Miko to hunt it,
{var:1} heads for Mount Huji, where it
was seen.
tm.そこで {var:1}たちは 化け物の正体が\nテバとサキという 兄妹が変装した:
There, {var:1} learns the monster was a
disguise worn by siblings Atsuo and Atsuko,
who want to stop Miko's fire rite. To hear
them out, {var:1} goes to the siblings'
secret hideout.
tm.秘密基地を訪れた {var:1}たちは\nテバから ヤヤクが 火の神の儀式をおこ:
At the hideout, Atsuo says that if Miko
holds the fire rite, the siblings' mother will
be sacrificed. At his request, the party
takes the hideout's back path to Mount
Huji.
tm.化け物に扮していた 兄妹の頼みを聞き\nヤヤクの秘密を暴くため ヒノノギ火山を訪:
At the siblings' request, the party goes to
Mount Huji to expose Miko's secret and
hears a voice from the crater. Peering in,
{var:1} sees the man-eating firedrake
Miko supposedly slew.
tm.ヤヤクは 火竜を倒せなかったために 火口に隠して\n今まで 村人たちをだましてい:
Atsuo rages that Miko failed to kill the
firedrake, hid it in the crater, and deceived
the villagers. {var:1} returns to the
village to tell them about the firedrake.
tm.魔王を倒す旅の途中 {var:1}たちは\nホムラの里の巫女 ヤヤクから 化け物:
On the quest to defeat the Dark One,
{var:1} is asked by Miko to hunt a
monster, but it's the siblings in disguise. At
Mount Huji with Atsuo, they see the
firedrake Miko supposedly slew.
tm.里に戻り 社へ向かった {var:1}とテバは\n村人たちに 火竜が生きていたこ:
Back at the shrine, {var:1} and Atsuo
tell the villagers the firedrake lives, but
Miko insists she slew it. She presses Atsuo
to reveal where his sacrificed mother is.
tm.その時 火竜が 里を襲いに現れ\n神官たちは 武器をかまえて しとめようとするが:
Then the firedrake attacks the village.
Priests ready weapons, but Miko shields the
beast, begging them not to kill it. The
firedrake swallows her whole.
tm.里に戻り ヤヤクの社へ向かった {var:1}とテバは\n村人たちに 火竜が生き:
Back at Miko's shrine, {var:1} and Atsuo
tell the villagers the firedrake lives. Then it
attacks the village, and {var:1} fights
the man-eating firedrake that swallowed
Miko.
tm.{var:1}たちが 戦いに勝利すると\n火竜は逃げていき 里は救われる。\nヤ:
After {var:1} wins, the firedrake flees
and the village is saved. Why Miko shielded
it remains a mystery. The party goes to
Miko's shrine for the gate key to the
firedrake's lair.
tm.魔王を倒す旅の途中 {var:1}たちは\nホムラの里の巫女 ヤヤクから 化け物:
On the quest to defeat the Dark One, a
disguised pair of siblings, Miko's request,
and a firedrake at Mount Huji lead to a
fight. The party drives off the firedrake
that swallowed Miko.
tm.逃げていった人食い火竜を退治するため\n山門のカギをもらいに ヤヤクの社を訪れた:
To hunt the fled firedrake, the party visits
Miko's shrine for the gate key. A
handmaiden hands them Miko's diary, telling
how her son Ryu became a firedrake and of
Miko's anguish.
tm.呪いを解き ハリマを元の姿に戻せるという やたの鏡は\nヤヤクと共に火竜に食べら:
Atsuo laments that the Yata Mirror, which
could free Ryu from his curse, was
swallowed with Miko. Asked to slay the evil
dragon, the party takes the gate key and
heads to the lair.
tm.逃げていった火竜を追い 一行が 火口にいる火竜を倒すと\nやたの鏡のチカラで ハ:
The party chases the firedrake into the
crater and defeats it. With the Yata Mirror's
power, Ryu regains his form, asks them to
pass on a message to Miko, and ascends.
They return to Hotto.
tm.ヤヤクを失い 里の未来をなげく村人たちだったが\nテバの チカラ強い言葉に励まさ:
Villagers mourn Miko and the village's
future, but Atsuo's strong words inspire
them to vow to protect Hotto themselves.
Watching over the village, {var:1}
resumes the quest against the Dark One.
tm.その後 ふたたび ホムラの里に戻った一行は\nヤヤクの侍女から 禁足地へのカギを:
Back in Hotto, the party gets the key to the
forbidden grounds from Miko's handmaiden
and heads to the Legendary Forge on
Mount Huji to forge the Luminary's sword.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\nシルビア号の船内で カ:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} reunites with Erik aboard the
Sylvando, but he has lost all memories
except his name. They take him along to
help him recover.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n記憶を失ってしまった:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} takes the amnesiac Erik to
Sniflheim, whose sea route is blocked by a
golden iceberg.
tm.クレイモラン王国の城下町は 静まりかえっており\n{var:1}たちは 異変を感:
Sniflheim's castle town is eerily quiet, and
{var:1} senses something wrong. With
Erik acting strangely since arrival,
{var:1} and Rab head to the castle to
speak with Queen Charlotte.
tm.ひさしぶりに再会を果たした シャールから\nすべてを黄金にしてしまう奇病……黄金:
Reunited with Charlotte, {var:1} hears
the kingdom is plagued by the Golden
Curse, a strange illness that turns
everything to gold. To find the cause, the
party returns to town to ask the people.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n記憶を失ってしまった:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} takes the amnesiac Erik to
Sniflheim. At the castle Queen Charlotte
tells of the Golden Curse, so the party
investigates the mystery.
tm.城下町に戻った {var:1}たちが\n住民の老婆に 話を聞こうとすると\n突然:
Back in town, as {var:1} questions an
old woman, she suddenly turns to gold
before their eyes. Erik is shaken at the
sight.
tm.そこへ 駆けつけた神父は\nカミュを知っており 彼がいることに おどろく。\n{:
A priest rushes over who knows Erik and is
astonished he is there. To learn more about
Erik, {var:1} heads to the town church.
tm.城下町で 老婆が黄金化するのを 目撃した後\n一行は 教会で カミュを知る神父か:
After seeing the old woman turn to gold,
the party hears Erik's past from the priest
who knows him: Erik and his sister, taken in
by Vikings, endured harsh years until she
died, and he vanished.
tm.カミュは そこまで話を聞くと\n突然 話をさえぎり 部屋を出ていってしまう。\n:
Hearing this far, Erik suddenly cuts in and
leaves the room. {var:1} and friends go
after him.
tm.城下町で 老婆が黄金化するのを 目撃した後\n一行は 教会で カミュを知る神父か:
After seeing the old woman turn to gold,
the party hears of Erik and his sister's hard
upbringing from the priest. Erik suddenly
leaves, and {var:1} finds him gazing at
the sea.
tm.その時 悲鳴が 辺りに響き渡り\n{var:1}とカミュは 港に近づく不審な船を:
A scream rings out, and {var:1} and Erik
see a suspicious ship nearing the port.
Leaving the shaken Erik with the priest, the
party runs to find a horde of Gold soldiers
serving Kilgore.
tm.港に近づく 不審な船を目撃した {var:1}たちが\n城下町に向かうと 六軍王:
Seeing the suspicious ship near the port,
{var:1} heads into town and finds
Kilgore's Gold soldiers loading golden people
onto a ship. Suspecting them, the party
fights to stop the looting.
tm.戦闘に勝利した一行だが 戦っている間に 残りの黄金兵が\n黄金化した人間を乗せ:
The party wins, but in the fight the
remaining Gold soldiers load golden people
aboard and set sail. Erik is among the
captured. {var:1} sets out to gather
intel on the Gold soldiers to get him back.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n記憶を失ったカミュとと:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} and the amnesiac Erik
investigate the Golden Curse in Sniflheim.
Kilgore's Gold soldiers appear carrying
golden people and capture Erik.
tm.黄金兵が去った後 {var:1}たちは 神父から\nこの地に寄港していた バイキ:
After the Gold soldiers leave, the priest
tells {var:1} their ways resemble those
of the Vikings who docked here. The party
heads to the Vikings' hideout to ask about
Erik.
tm.去っていった黄金兵の言動やクセが バイキングと\n似ていたと神父から聞き 一行は:
Told the Gold soldiers act like the Vikings,
the party visits their hideout. Gold soldiers
loiter there, and Erik is locked in a cell as
tribute to Kilgore.

Told the Gold soldiers act like the Vikings,
the party visits their hideout. Gold soldiers
loiter there, and to save Erik, locked up as
tribute for Kilgore, the party fights them.
tm.黄金兵を倒し カミュを助けだした 一行だったが\nカミュは ブツブツと 何かをつ:
Having beaten the Gold soldiers and
rescued Erik, the party sees him mutter and
wander off. {var:1} follows him.
tm.黄金兵を倒し カミュを助けだした 一行だったが\nカミュは 何かをつぶやきながら:
Having beaten the Gold soldiers and
rescued Erik, the party follows him as he
mutters and walks away, and reaches a
place where the roots of a great tree grow.
tm.{var:1}が 大樹の根に触れると\nバイキングのもとで はたらく\nカミュと:
When {var:1} touches the roots, a vision
appears of Erik and his sister Maya working
for the Vikings. Though in harsh conditions,
they dreamed of one day being free.
tm.黄金兵を倒し カミュを助けだした 一行だったが\nカミュは 何かをつぶやきながら:
Having rescued Erik, the party follows him
to the roots of a great tree. When
{var:1} touches them, a vision appears
of Erik and his sister Maya working for the
Vikings.
tm.{var:1}が ふたたび 大樹の根に触れると\nカミュが マヤの誕生日に\nあ:
When {var:1} touches the roots again, a
vision shows Erik giving Maya a necklace
for her birthday. Whoever wore it gained
the power to turn everything they touched
to gold.
tm.黄金兵を倒し カミュを助けだした 一行は\n歩いていくカミュを追いかけ 大樹の根:
Having rescued Erik, the party follows him
to the roots. Touching them shows that Erik
and Maya worked for the Vikings, and that
he gave Maya a necklace that turns what it
touches to gold.
tm.{var:1}が ふたたび 大樹の根に触れると\n黄金化のチカラが暴走し カミュ:
When {var:1} touches the roots again, a
vision shows the golden power running wild
and Maya turning to gold while Erik can't
save her. Guilt-ridden, he sealed their
hideout and left.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n記憶を失ったカミュと:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} and the amnesiac Erik reach the
Gold soldiers' hideout. Seeing the past at
the roots in Windy Hollow, Erik regained all
his lost memories.
tm.勇者にチカラを貸すことで 贖罪が果たされるという\nかつて 預言者に言われた言葉:
Remembering the Seer's words that lending
strength to the Luminary would atone for
his sins, Erik rejoins the party. To restore
the golden people, they head for Kilgore's
lair.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\nクレイモラン王国を襲っ:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria, the
party investigates the Golden Curse, and in
the process Erik regains all his memories.
To save the golden people and Maya, they
press through the Golden Castle.
tm.しかし 玉座の間にたどり着くと 黄金化したはずのマヤが\n元の姿に戻っており 玉:
But in the throne room, Maya, who had
turned to gold, is back to normal and sits on
the throne. She says the Dark One revived
her as Kilgore. To atone, Erik fights Kilgore
with the party.
tm.キラゴルドを倒した {var:1}たちだったが\nマヤを取り込んだまま キラゴル:
The party defeats Kilgore, but he runs wild
with Maya absorbed within. Erik readies his
weapon to stop him, but {var:1} realizes
Maya, back to her senses, is calling Erik's
name for help.
tm.{var:1}は 今でもなお\n兄と妹をしばり続ける わだかまりを解くため\nキ:
To break the grudge still binding brother
and sister, {var:1} tries to stop Erik, who
has readied his weapon to defeat Maya,
who is Kilgore.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\nクレイモラン王国を襲っ:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria, the
party investigates the Golden Curse and
Erik regains his memories. In the Golden
Castle's throne room, they learn Kilgore is
really Erik's sister, Maya.
tm.キラゴルドを倒したことで 正気に戻ったマヤに気づいた\n {var:1}は 彼女:
After Kilgore falls, {var:1} notices Maya
has come to her senses and stops Erik from
striking her. Rethinking, Erik embraces
Maya despite turning to gold, freeing her
from Kilgore's curse.
tm.こうして クレイモラン王国は 黄金病の脅威から解放され\n元に戻ったマヤも 神父:
Sniflheim is freed from the Golden Curse,
and Maya, restored, is left in the priest's
care. As prophesied, Erik atones by lending
strength to the Luminary, and the party
resumes its quest against Mordegon.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n道中で ネドラという魔:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} is attacked by the dread dragon
Nedra and nearly dies. Rescuing the party
is Serena, a comrade from battles past.
tm.セーニャは {var:1}たちの話を聞き\nドゥルダ郷で大師が言っていた 神の乗:
Hearing {var:1}'s tale, Serena says the
elder of Arboria may know about the divine
vessel the Grand Master mentioned at
Angri-La. Serena rejoins, and the party
heads for Arboria.
tm.ふたたび セーニャを仲間に加えた {var:1}たちは\n神の乗り物について 長:
With Serena back, the party visits Arboria
to ask the elder about the divine vessel, but
the once-beautiful holy land is changed
beyond recognition. Sensing Veronica,
Serena leads the way to find her.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n道中で かつて共に戦っ:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria, the
party meets old comrade Serena, and they
visit Arboria to ask the elder about the
divine vessel. Sensing Veronica, Serena
leads them to find her.
tm.{var:1}たちは 眠っているベロニカを見つけるが\nセーニャが呼びかけても:
{var:1} finds Veronica asleep, but she
won't wake. Suddenly her staff glows with
the same light as Yggdrasil's guidance, and
when {var:1} touches it, the day
Yggdrasil fell appears.
tm.ウルノーガが 魔王として誕生した時\nベロニカは 自らの命と引き換えに\n{va:
When Mordegon was born as the Dark One,
Veronica gave her life to protect {var:1}
and friends. Realizing she is gone from this
world, the party returns to Arboria in
despair.
tm.セーニャが示す先に向かった {var:1}たちは\nベロニカが 魔王ウルノーガの:
Following Serena, {var:1} learns that
when Mordegon rose as the Dark One,
Veronica gave her life to protect them.
Realizing she is gone, the party heads to
Arboria in despair.
tm.ベロニカの死を知った 聖地ラムダの人々により\nベロニカの葬儀が とりおこなわれ:
Learning of Veronica's death, the people of
Arboria hold her funeral. As they see her
off, the party is called by the elder, Fanard,
and goes to the Cathedral.
tm.セーニャが示す先に向かった {var:1}たちは\nベロニカが 魔王ウルノーガの:
Following Serena, {var:1} learns
Veronica gave her life to protect them
when Mordegon was born. After attending
her funeral in Arboria, the party is called by
Elder Fanard to the Cathedral.
tm.一行は 長老から 神の乗り物について聞く。\n天高く 空を翔けめぐる 神の使い:
The elder tells the party of the divine
vessel: Cetacea, the messenger of the gods
who soars the skies. He dreamed {var:1}
riding Cetacea to a floating island, saying
that is where they must go.
tm.長老は 神の使い ケトスの存在について語ると\n天に浮かぶ島こそ 目指すべき地な:
The elder speaks of Cetacea, the gods'
messenger, and says the island floating in
the sky is their destination. He promises to
look into Cetacea. The party rests at the
inn, but {var:1} cannot sleep.
tm.仲間を探しながら ラムダを目指す {var:1}たちは\n道中で セーニャに出会:
Seeking allies on the way to Arboria,
{var:1} meets Serena and visits Arboria
with her. Led by Serena, they learn
Veronica gave her life to protect them
when Mordegon was born as the Dark One.
tm.{var:1}たちが ベロニカの葬儀に立ちあっていると\n長老のファナードに呼ば:
At Veronica's funeral, {var:1} is called
by Elder Fanard to hear about the divine
vessel. He promises to look into Cetacea.
The party rests at the inn, but {var:1}
cannot sleep.
tm.{var:1}は 雨が降りしきるテラスで\nひとり 竪琴を弾いているセーニャの姿:
On a rain-soaked terrace, {var:1} finds
Serena playing her harp alone. She tearfully
recalls memories of her sister, then cuts
her hair and bids Veronica farewell.
Veronica's will lives on in Serena.
tm.ベロニカの葬儀に立ちあった {var:1}たちは\n長老のファナードから いにし:
After attending Veronica's funeral,
{var:1} hears from Elder Fanard of the
ancient legend and Cetacea, the divine
vessel. That night, Serena bids Veronica
farewell and inherits her will.
tm.翌朝 ゼーランダ山の山頂に向かった {var:1}は\n長老のファナードから セ:
Next morning {var:1} climbs
Zwaardsrust Summit, receives Senya's flute
from Elder Fanard, and calls Cetacea. To
defeat Mordegon for Veronica, the party
soars off to find the island in the sky.
tm.神の乗り物 ケトスを呼び寄せた {var:1}たちは\n魔王の闇を打ち払うチカラ:
Having called the divine vessel Cetacea,
{var:1} visits a mysterious floating
island to gain the power to dispel the Dark
One's darkness. In the island's temple, they
meet a child of another race.
tm.子供は ロトゼタシア創世の時代から\n世界を見守ってきた 神の民と呼ばれる一族で:
The child is of the Divine Folk, who have
watched over the world since the dawn of
Erdrea. {var:1} hears the Dark One's
army attacked their village, and only he
survived, protected by the Sacred Ember.
tm.魔王の闇をはらうチカラについて\n神の民の子供には 心当たりがなく\n一行は 大:
The Divine Folk child knows nothing of a
power to dispel the Dark One's darkness.
The party decides to look into the Sacred
Ember, said to hold great power.
tm.{var:1}が 神殿の奥にある 聖なる種火に近づくと\n種火の炎が 勇者のアザ:
{var:1} nears the Sacred Ember in the
temple, and its flame reacts to the
Luminary's mark and moves into a vessel.
The party obtains it, then investigates
three saplings with Yggdrasil-like power.
tm.{var:1}たちは 神の民である子供から\n魔王軍が 神の民の里を 襲ったこと:
{var:1} hears from the Divine Folk child
that the Dark One's army attacked their
village. Nearing the Sacred Ember in the
temple, its flame reacts to the Luminary's
mark, and the party obtains it.
tm.その後 {var:1}が 神殿にある苗木を調べると\n鉱石を持つ 伝説の勇者ロー:
Then, when {var:1} examines a sapling
in the temple, the legendary Luminary
Erdwin and his companions appear, holding
ore. To find a way to dispel the darkness,
the party examines the other saplings.
tm.{var:1}たちは 神の民である子供から\n魔王軍が 神の民の里を 襲ったこと:
{var:1} hears from the Divine Folk child
that the Dark One's army attacked their
village. After getting the Sacred Ember,
{var:1} examines a sapling and sees
Erdwin and his companions holding ore.
tm.さらに {var:1}が 神殿にある苗木を調べると \nハンマーを持つ 勇者ロー:
Examining another sapling, {var:1} sees
Erdwin and his companions holding a
hammer. To find a way to dispel the Dark
One's darkness, the party decides to
examine the last sapling.
tm.神の乗り物 ケトスを呼び寄せた {var:1}たちは\n魔王の闇を打ち払うチカラ:
Having called Cetacea, {var:1} goes to
the Divine Folk's village in the sky to gain
the power to dispel the Dark One's
darkness. At the Temple of the Sun there,
the party meets a Divine Folk child.
tm.その後 聖なる種火を手に入れた {var:1}たちが\n神殿にある ３本の苗木を:
After obtaining the Sacred Ember,
{var:1} examines the temple's three
saplings. They show Erdwin, who gathered
ore and hammers, forging a sword in a
great forge.
tm.それが 勇者のつるぎを作る光景だと知った\n{var:1}たちは 魔王を倒すため:
Learning this was the making of the
Luminary's sword, {var:1} resolves to
forge a new one to defeat the Dark One.
The party sets out in search of the
materials and a forge to work them.
tm.その後 聖なる種火を手に入れた {var:1}たちが\n神殿にある ３本の苗木を:
After obtaining the Sacred Ember,
{var:1} examines the temple's three
saplings, which show Erdwin forging the
Luminary's sword. The party resolves to
forge a new one to defeat the Dark One.
tm.世界を旅し オリハルコンとガイアのハンマーを手に入れた\n{var:1}たちは:
After a journey for Orichalcum and Gaia's
hammer, {var:1} completes the
Luminary's sword at the Legendary Forge.
With power to dispel darkness, the party
heads for the Fortress of Fear.
tm.世界を旅し 材料を手に入れた {var:1}たちは\n伝説の鍛冶場で 勇者のつる:
With materials gathered, {var:1}
completes the Luminary's sword at the
Legendary Forge. Riding Cetacea to the
Fortress of Fear, the party dispels its
barrier of darkness and storms in.
tm.魔王ウルノーガを倒すため\n天空魔城に乗り込んだ {var:1}たち。\n天空魔:
{var:1} storms the Fortress of Fear to
defeat Mordegon. The party beats Garinga,
one of the Dark One's generals and the
fortress's guardian, and heads inside.
tm.大広間に入ると {var:1}たちの前に\n死んだはずの ベロニカが現れるが\n:
In the great hall, Veronica appears before
{var:1}, but vanishes at the sound of
Serena's harp. It was an illusion by Dark
Marshal Jasper, who reveals himself and
attacks as a monster.
tm.{var:1}たちが ホメロスを倒すと\nホメロスは グレイグに対する思いをクチ:
When {var:1} defeats Jasper, he voices
his feelings about Hendrik: "I only wanted to
be like you..." With that, Jasper disappears.
tm.魔王ウルノーガを倒すため 天空魔城に乗り込んだ\n{var:1}たちは 行く手を:
{var:1} storms the Fortress of Fear to
defeat Mordegon. After beating Garinga
and Jasper, the party nears the summit,
where Jasper revives the generals and
restrains the party.
tm.しかし {var:1}と共に戦うという 仲間たちの決意が\nチカラとなって 拘束:
But the party's resolve to fight with
{var:1} breaks their bonds and destroys
the generals. Jasper lives on, vowing to
surpass Hendrik, but Hendrik's words "You
were my light..." finally undo him.
tm.六軍王を倒した {var:1}たちは\nすべてを狂わせた元凶……\n魔王ウルノー:
Having beaten the generals, {var:1} and
friends head for Mordegon, the cause of it
all.
tm.死闘の末 とうとう すべての元凶である\n魔王ウルノーガを倒した {var:1}:
After a desperate battle, {var:1}
defeats Mordegon, the root of all evil.
Yggdrasil, fallen to earth, is revived, and
light returns to the ravaged world.
tm.使命を果たした {var:1}たちは\nそれぞれ 自分たちの故郷へと帰っていった:
Their mission fulfilled, {var:1} and
friends return to their own homelands. And
then...
tm.{var:1}たちが 魔王ウルノーガを倒し\n世界に平和が訪れてから 数日後……:
Days after {var:1} defeats Mordegon
and peace returns, the party visits Arboria
to mourn Veronica.
tm.魔王の手により 多くの命が失われたが\n命の大樹が よみがえり 本当に世界を救っ:
Though many lives were lost to the Dark
One, the party feels deeply that Yggdrasil
has revived and truly saved the world.
After the Arboria feast, they tour the
now-peaceful world.
tm.ラムダの宴の後 平和になった世界を旅する 一行は\nユグノア地方にある 謎の遺跡:
After the Arboria feast, the party travels
the peaceful world and visits a mysterious
ruin in Dundrasil. Its broken buildings
suggest ties to the Divine Folk's village, so
{var:1} explores inside.
tm.{var:1}たちが 魔王ウルノーガを倒し\n世界に平和が訪れてから 数日後……:
Days after {var:1} defeats Mordegon
and peace returns, the party mourns
Veronica in Arboria, then visits a
mysterious ruin in Dundrasil.
tm.遺跡の中を調べると ロウが古い書物を発見し\n神の民が書いた その書物には\n失:
Exploring the ruins, Rab finds an old book
by the Divine Folk about a spirit called the
Avatar of Lost Time. The sacred light of
time it guards can revive what was lost.
tm.それが本当なら ベロニカは生き返る……。\nたとえ わずかな希望でも それに懸け:
If true, Veronica could live again. Moved by
Serena's hope, however slim, {var:1} and
friends head deep into the ruins for the
Mystic cog needed to reach the tower
where that sacred light sleeps.
tm.ロウが見つけた 神の民が書いた 古い書物を読み\n{var:1}たちは 失われた:
Reading the old book by the Divine Folk
that Rab found, {var:1} gains hope that
the Avatar of Lost Time's light can revive
Veronica. The party finds the Mystic cog
deep in the ruins.
tm.命の大樹の北に さびれた塔があることを思いだした\nカミュは ケトスに乗って そ:
Erik recalls a forlorn tower north of
Yggdrasil and suggests going there on
Cetacea. {var:1} sets out for it, where
mysterious spirits that only {var:1} can
see, perhaps Avatars of Lost Time, gather.
tm.世界に平和が訪れた後 {var:1}たちは\n神の民が書いた書物から 失ったもの:
After peace returns, {var:1} learns from
the Divine Folk's book of a tower holding a
sacred light that revives what was lost. The
party gets the Mystic cog and heads for
the tower of Avatars of Lost Time.
tm.失われた時の化身が集まる塔……。\nその扉の穴に 神秘の歯車をはめ\n閉ざされた:
At the tower of Avatars of Lost Time, the
party sets the Mystic cog in the door and
opens it, then steps inside.
tm.忘れられた塔の最上階で {var:1}たちは\n時の流れを見守る存在だという 時:
At the top of the Tower of Lost Time,
{var:1} meets the Keeper of Time, who
watches time's flow. Asked about the light
that revives the lost, the Keeper says the
Orb of Time can rewind the world.
tm.時のオーブのチカラを使えば 大樹が落ちる前に戻り\nベロニカをはじめ あの日に失:
With the Orb of Time, the party could return
to before Yggdrasil fell and save Veronica
and all they lost. But only {var:1} can go
back, and cannot return to this world.
{var:1} must decide.
tm.世界に平和が訪れた後 {var:1}たちは\n神の民が書いた書物から 失ったもの:
After peace returns, {var:1} learns from
the Divine Folk's book of a tower with a
sacred light that revives what was lost.
There, the party meets the Keeper of Time,
watcher of time's flow.
tm.時のオーブのチカラを使えば 大樹が落ちる前に戻り\nベロニカをはじめ あの日に失:
With the Orb of Time, they could return to
before Yggdrasil fell and save all they lost.
But learning only {var:1} can go back
and never return, the party stands in
{var:1}'s way to stop it.
tm.しかし {var:1}の 決意の表情を見たカミュは\nその決断を信じ もう一度:
But seeing {var:1}'s determined face,
Erik trusts the choice and tells {var:1}
to save the world once more. The others
agree with Erik, and open the path to the
altar of the Orb of Time.
tm.時のオーブのチカラを使えば 大樹が落ちる前に戻り\nベロニカをはじめ あの日に失:
With the Orb of Time, they could return to
before Yggdrasil fell and save all they lost.
But learning only {var:1} can go back
and never return, the party decides to trust
{var:1} and send the Luminary off.
tm.{var:1}が 勇者のつるぎを振り下ろし\n時のオーブを壊すと 時が 巻き戻っ:
{var:1} swings the Luminary's sword and
breaks the Orb of Time. Time rewinds, and
{var:1} finds himself in a peaceful
Zwaardsrust, back before Yggdrasil fell.
tm.過ぎ去りし時を求めた {var:1}は\n魔王の剣と共に 過去のゼーランダ山へと:
Seeking the days gone by, {var:1}
returns to Zwaardsrust in the past with the
Dark One's sword. {var:1} meets
Veronica and the others in Arboria and
heads for Yggdrasil.
tm.大樹の神域に向かった {var:1}は\nかつて経験した時と同じように ホメロス:
Heading to Yggdrasil's sanctuary,
{var:1} is attacked by Jasper as before.
But using the Dark One's sword to dispel
the darkness, {var:1} escapes the fate
of being struck down by Jasper.
tm.そこに グレイグ将軍が デルカダール王と共に現れる。\nまだ息のあったホメロスは:
Then General Hendrik arrives with the King
of Heliodor. Jasper, still alive, tries to tell
the king something, but the king finishes
him, points out Mordegon, and tells
{var:1} to take the Luminary's sword.
tm.過ぎ去りし時を求めた {var:1}は\n魔王の剣と共に 過去のゼーランダ山へと:
Seeking the days gone by, {var:1}
returns to Zwaardsrust with the Dark One's
sword, meets the others in Arboria, and
heads for Yggdrasil, where Jasper attacks
just as before.
tm.{var:1}は 魔王の剣で 闇のチカラをはらい\nホメロスに倒されるという 運:
{var:1} dispels the darkness with the
Dark One's sword and escapes Jasper's
blow. General Hendrik arrives with the King
of Heliodor. Jasper tries to say something
to the king, who finishes him there.
tm.{var:1}は 大樹の魂の中に入り\nついに 勇者のつるぎを 手に入れる。\n:
{var:1} enters Yggdrasil's spirit and at
last obtains the Luminary's sword.
Something from {var:1}'s shadow blocks
the King of Heliodor from touching it, and
he leaves, inviting the party to his castle.
tm.{var:1}は 魔王の剣で 闇のチカラを打ち払い\nホメロスに倒されるという:
{var:1} dispels the darkness with the
Dark One's sword and escapes Jasper's
blow. The King of Heliodor arrives with
Hendrik, sees the Luminary's sword taken,
and invites them to his castle.
tm.デルカダール城を訪れた {var:1}たちは\nペルラとエマと会い イシの村の人:
At Heliodor Castle, {var:1} meets Amber
and Gemma and learns Hendrik sheltered
Cobblestone's people. The king
acknowledges {var:1} as the true
Luminary and hosts a feast.
tm.{var:1}は デルカダール城で 真の勇者と認められ\nもてなしを受けた後 貴:
{var:1} is acknowledged as the true
Luminary at Heliodor Castle, feasted, and
put to bed in a guest room. That night the
king tries to steal the Luminary's sword, but
the party exposes him as a monster.
tm.過ぎ去りし時を求めた {var:1}は\n魔王の剣と共に 過去のゼーランダ山へと:
Seeking the days gone by, {var:1}
returns to Zwaardsrust in the past with the
Dark One's sword, heads to Yggdrasil with
the others, and escapes Jasper's blow by
using the sword.
tm.{var:1}は ホメロスを倒したことを\nデルカダール王に感謝され 城に招待さ:
{var:1} is thanked by the King of
Heliodor for defeating Jasper and invited to
the castle. There the king acknowledges
{var:1} as the true Luminary and hosts a
feast late into the night.
tm.その夜 {var:1}が眠っている貴賓室に 王が現れ\n勇者のつるぎを奪おうとす:
That night the king tries to steal the
Luminary's sword and flees to the throne
room. The monster in disguise is Mordegon.
Once he falls, the real king awakens and
reunites with Jade after sixteen years.
tm.そして 祝宴に招かれた デルカダール城で\n王の正体が 魔道士ウルノーガと知った:
Invited to a feast at Heliodor Castle,
{var:1} learns the king is Mordegon and
finally fights the cause of the Luminary's
fate. The real king awakens and reunites
with Jade after sixteen years.
tm.{var:1}は 本物の王から 感謝され\nローシュの名を継ぐ 勇者の称号を授け:
{var:1} is thanked by the real king and
granted the title of Luminary, bearing
Erdwin's name. As the castle celebrates, it
darkens and word comes of trouble with
the Luminary's Star.
tm.{var:1}は 本物の王から 勇者の称号を授けられ\n一行は ロトゼタシアが救:
{var:1} is granted the title of Luminary
by the real king, and all rejoice that Erdrea
is saved. But then the Luminary's Star falls.
With Hendrik newly joined, the party sets
out to investigate.
tm.デルカダール王から 落ちた勇者の星の様子を\n見てきてくれと頼まれた {var::
Asked by the King of Heliodor to see how
the fallen Luminary's Star fares, {var:1}
visits the Emerald Coast. From the shore,
an ominous black sun hangs in the sky
above Gallopolis Desert.
tm.一行が どうすることもできず 途方に暮れていると\nそこへ ウルノーガが現れる。:
As the party stands helpless, Mordegon
appears, but he is actually the Seer, who
has taken a woman's form. She says
{var:1} will ride Cetacea and meet the
Celestrians.
tm.伝説の笛の音が かの地へ導く…… そう言い残して\n預言者は消え {var:1}:
"The legendary flute's sound will guide you
there..." The Seer vanishes. Following her
words, {var:1} plays Veronica's flute and
the flying whale Cetacea appears, carrying
the party to find the Celestrians.
tm.落ちた勇者の星の様子を探るため\nデルカコスタ地方を訪れた {var:1}たちは:
Visiting the Emerald Coast to check on the
fallen Luminary's Star, {var:1} sees a
black sun over Gallopolis Desert. As the
party stands helpless, the Seer appears in
Mordegon's form.
tm.預言者は 一行が 神の使いケトスに乗って\n天空の民と出会う姿が見えると言い残し:
The Seer says {var:1} will ride Cetacea
and meet the Celestrians, then vanishes.
Relying on her words, {var:1} calls
Cetacea and finds the Divine Folk, servants
of Yggdrasil, on a floating island.
tm.長老イゴルタプと面会し 邪神と勇者の神話を聞いた\n一行は 邪神を倒すという 勇:
Meeting Elder Igoltap, the party hears the
myth of the Dark God and the Luminary's
duty to defeat him. Koron wants to give
them something, so they go to the Temple
of the Sun.
tm.落ちた勇者の星の様子を探るため\nデルカコスタ地方を訪れた {var:1}たちは:
Visiting the Emerald Coast, {var:1} sees
a black sun over Gallopolis Desert. The
Seer appears and says {var:1} will ride
the gods' messenger Cetacea and meet the
Celestrians, then vanishes.
tm.預言者の言葉を頼りに ケトスを呼びだした\n{var:1}たちは 天空に浮かぶ:
Relying on the Seer's words, {var:1}
calls Cetacea and visits the Divine Folk's
village. Elder Igoltap tells of the Luminary's
duty to defeat the Dark God. Koron asks
them to come to the Temple of the Sun.
tm.太陽の神殿で 聖なる種火を手に入れた\n{var:1}たちは 邪神討伐の糸口をつ:
At the Temple of the Sun, {var:1} gets
