the Sacred Ember. To find a way to defeat
the Dark God, the party sets out to seek
three sacred saplings on the surface, after
Igoltap unlocks their new power.
tm.落ちた勇者の星の様子を探るため\nデルカコスタ地方を訪れた {var:1}たちは:
Visiting the Emerald Coast, {var:1} sees
a black sun over Gallopolis Desert.
Following the Seer's words, the party calls
Cetacea and visits the Divine Folk's village
in the sky.
tm.長老イゴルタプと面会し 邪神と勇者の神話を聞いた\n一行は 邪神を倒すという 勇:
Meeting Elder Igoltap, the party hears the
myth of the Dark God and the Luminary and
learns the Luminary's duty. They get the
Sacred Ember at the Temple of the Sun and
seek three saplings on the surface.
tm.世界を巡り すべての苗木を調べた {var:1}たちは\nケトスが 邪神の結界を:
After searching the world and examining
every sapling, {var:1} learns Cetacea
can break the Dark God's barrier. Guided by
the Seer, a grown-up Veronica and Serena
pray and become Trees of Guidance.
tm.長老イゴルタプと面会し 邪神を倒すという\n勇者の使命を知った 一行は 聖なる種:
Meeting Elder Igoltap, the party learns the
Luminary's duty to defeat the Dark God,
gets the Sacred Ember, and seeks the
saplings. Examining all, {var:1} learns
Cetacea can break the Dark God's barrier.
tm.そこに現れた 預言者の導きのもと ベロニカとセーニャが\n祈りを捧げると ふたり:
Guided by the Seer, Veronica and Serena
pray and become Trees of Guidance. When
{var:1} touches one, a vision shows
Erdwin betrayed by his companion Uranos
just before defeating the Dark God.
tm.落ちた勇者の星の様子を探るため\nデルカコスタ地方を訪れた {var:1}たちは:
Visiting the Emerald Coast, {var:1} sees
a black sun over Gallopolis Desert.
Following the Seer, the party calls Cetacea,
visits the Divine Folk's village, and hears of
the Luminary's duty to defeat the Dark God.
tm.ケトスが 邪神の結界を破るチカラを持つと知った\n{var:1}は 預言者の首飾:
Learning Cetacea can break the Dark God's
barrier, {var:1} watches with the Seer's
necklace as Veronica and Serena become
Trees of Guidance. Touching one shows
Erdwin dying, betrayed by Uranos.
tm.{var:1}が ふたたび 導きの木に手をかざすと\nセニカが 邪神を封印した後:
Touching a Tree again, {var:1} learns
that after sealing the Dark God, Senya went
to the Tower of Lost Time to meet Erdwin
and became its Keeper of Time. The Seer
confesses he is Uranos.
tm.ケトスが 邪神の結界を破るチカラを持つと知った\n{var:1}は 預言者の首飾:
Learning Cetacea can break the Dark God's
barrier, {var:1} sees Veronica and
Serena become Trees of Guidance, and
learns Erdwin was betrayed by Uranos and
Senya became the Keeper of Time.
tm.預言者は 自分が ウラノスであることを告白し\n邪神のチカラを吸い取った 悪の心:
The Seer confesses he is Uranos: his evil,
which absorbed the Dark God's power,
became Mordegon; his good became the
Seer. The party seeks the Divine Folk's help
to reach the Tower of Lost Time.
tm.ケトスが 邪神の結界を破るチカラを持つと知った\n{var:1}は ベロニカとセ:
Learning Cetacea can break the Dark God's
barrier, {var:1} touches the Trees of
Guidance, learns Erdwin's tragic end and
Senya's fate, and the Seer reveals he is the
good in Uranos.
tm.一行は 神の民のチカラを借り 忘れられた塔へ行けという\n預言者の言葉にしたがい:
Following the Seer's words, the party goes
to the Divine Folk's village, where Igoltap
gives them the Mystic cog. They then head
for the Tower of Lost Time, where Senya,
the Keeper of Time, waits.
tm.神の民の里で 神秘の歯車を手に入れた 一行は\n忘れられた塔で セニカと出会い\:
With the Mystic cog, the party meets Senya
in the Tower of Lost Time. At her guidance,
Veronica and Serena play a melody, light
fills the Luminary's sword, and Cetacea
awakens to face the Dark God.
tm.落ちた勇者の星の様子を探る {var:1}たちは\nサマディー地方の上空に浮かぶ:
Investigating the fallen Luminary's Star,
{var:1} sees a black sun over Gallopolis
Desert. Following the Seer, the party visits
the Divine Folk and learns the Luminary's
duty and Cetacea's power.
tm.{var:1}たちは 導きの木へ手をかざし\nローシュたちの悲劇的な運命を知った:
{var:1} touches the Trees of Guidance,
learns Erdwin's tragic fate, meets Senya in
the Tower of Lost Time, and awakens
Cetacea. With the means to break the
barrier, {var:1} challenges Calasmos.
tm.激しい戦いの末 邪神を倒した {var:1}たちは\nセニカに会うために 忘れら:
After a fierce battle, {var:1} defeats the
Dark God and visits Senya at the Tower of
Lost Time. Restored to human form, she
returns to the past to meet her love. The
party returns home to peaceful days.
tm.邪神ニズゼルファを倒した {var:1}たちは\n忘れられた塔に向かい 人間の姿:
After defeating Calasmos, {var:1} sees
Sage Senya, restored to human form,
return to the past at the Tower of Lost
Time to meet her love. Erdrea at peace,
everyone returns home to quiet days.
tm.そんな ある日 愛妻エマとの幸せな日々を送っていた\n{var:1}の前に ベロ:
One day, as {var:1} lives happily with
Gemma, Veronica and Serena appear and
invite {var:1} on a short journey.
Following Sage Senya, {var:1} dedicates
the Luminary's sword at Yggdrasil.
tm.そんな ある日 {var:1}の前に\nベロニカと セーニャが現れる。\nふたり:
One day, Veronica and Serena appear and
invite {var:1} on a short journey.
Following Sage Senya, {var:1} visits
Yggdrasil to dedicate the Luminary's sword,
a symbol of Erdrea's hope.
